title: Veloq link protocol
description: Every method of the link with the JSON it takes and answers, protocol 2 to 3.

units.metre_per_second: a speed in metres a second
units.watt_per_kilogram: a power in watts a kilogram
units.beat_per_minute: a heart rate in beats a minute
units.percent: a share of a whole, in percent
units.tss_per_week: a change in training load over a week, in TSS
units.epoch_second: an instant as seconds since the Unix epoch
units.point: a point on the rating or score scale the field names
units.degree: an angle of latitude or longitude, in degrees
units.year: a calendar year, as a whole number
units.ratio: a dimensionless ratio, or a fraction of one
units.index: a position in a list, series or scale the field names, counted as its doc says
units.identifier: an opaque number that names a thing, compared and never added
units.code: a whole number from the small set its doc comment lists
units.epoch_millisecond: an instant as milliseconds since the Unix epoch
units.metre_per_hour: a climb rate in metres an hour
units.second_per_kilometre: a pace in seconds a kilometre
units.beat_second_per_kilometre: a heart rate in beats a minute times a pace in seconds a kilometre
units.tss_per_day: a change in training load a day, in TSS
units.tss_or_percent: form, in TSS or as a percent of fitness, as the flag beside the field says
units.trimp: a training impulse in TRIMP units
units.swolf: a swimming efficiency score: seconds plus strokes for a length
units.standard_deviation: a distance from an average, in standard deviations
units.varies: a number whose unit another field of the record, or the field doc, names

methods.name: link.hello
methods.description: Negotiates the protocol version: the page names the newest and oldest it speaks and the phone answers with the highest both hold, its app version, its device name and the methods it answers. A page sends it first.

methods.name: feed.page
methods.description: One page of the activity feed, narrowed by a search, sport families and a span of start times.

methods.name: feed.summary
methods.description: The feed's summary card for a span of dates.

methods.name: feed.sparklines
methods.description: The wellness sparklines the feed shows above its list.

methods.name: feed.highlights

methods.name: feed.filterBounds

methods.name: activity.summary
methods.description: One activity's summary fields.

methods.name: activity.detail
methods.description: The activity detail screen's data for one activity.

methods.name: activity.record
methods.description: One activity's stored body typed as the detail screen reads it, or none when nothing is stored.

methods.name: activity.streams
methods.description: The chart series of one activity as little-endian 64-bit float runs, a gap being NaN, with the track in the engine's own encoding.

methods.name: activity.intervals
methods.description: The laps of one activity, or none when its body was never fetched or will not parse.

methods.name: activity.sections

methods.name: activity.exerciseSets

methods.name: insights.data

methods.name: insights.plannedEvents

methods.name: insights.workoutSections

methods.name: routes.screen
methods.description: The routes screen's data: the route groups and sections the phone has found, narrowed by the query.

methods.name: route.detail
methods.description: One route group's detail screen data.

methods.name: route.performance
methods.description: The lap reads of one route over a range of days for one sport, as the section detail reads them.

methods.name: route.attempts
methods.description: The attempts at one route, narrowed by the activity being viewed and a sport, with the route's performance.

methods.name: section.detail
methods.description: One section's detail screen data.

methods.name: section.performance

methods.name: section.standing
methods.description: Where one section stands: its trend and a page of recent attempts over a range of days, in a few kilobytes.

methods.name: section.history

methods.name: section.extensionTrack
methods.description: The activity a section is cut from, its whole stored track and the inclusive indices where the section's line runs on it.

methods.name: section.excluded

methods.name: sections.retired

methods.name: fitness.screen
methods.description: The fitness screen's data: fitness, fatigue and form over the span asked.

methods.name: fitness.wellness
methods.description: The daily wellness rows over a span of dates.

methods.name: fitness.loads
methods.description: The training load of each day over a span of dates.

methods.name: fitness.zones

methods.name: fitness.powerCurve
methods.description: The best power at each duration over a span of dates.

methods.name: fitness.paceCurve

methods.name: fitness.bestEfforts
methods.description: The best efforts screen's data over a window of days, where 0 is all time.

methods.name: strength.screen

methods.name: strength.exercise
methods.description: The detail of one exercise: its history and records.

methods.name: strength.muscle
methods.description: The sets of one muscle group in one activity, grouped by exercise, primary and secondary work classed apart.

methods.name: strength.picker
methods.description: The exercise picker's narrowed list and the vocabulary its filters use, for the filters and query asked.

methods.name: strength.lastTime
methods.description: What the athlete did last time for one exercise, or none for an exercise never done.

methods.name: strength.groups
methods.description: The recent strength groups, newest first.

methods.name: strength.workouts

methods.name: strength.live

methods.name: recordings.get

methods.name: map.screen

methods.name: geo.routeLines

methods.name: geo.track

methods.name: geo.activityOverlay
methods.description: The overlay drawn over one activity, as GeoJSON text.

methods.name: geo.sections

methods.name: geo.route

methods.name: geo.routeLatest
methods.description: The latest attempt at one route group, as GeoJSON text.

methods.name: geo.routeAttempts

methods.name: geo.section
methods.description: One section's line, as GeoJSON text, or packed and capped when asked.

methods.name: geo.sectionVersion
methods.description: One earlier version of a section's line, as GeoJSON text.

methods.name: geo.sectionPasses
methods.description: The passes made of one section, as GeoJSON text.

methods.name: nearby.places
methods.description: Routes and sections near a point, nearest first, each line packed and capped when asked.

methods.name: heatmap.tile

methods.name: heatmap.progress
methods.description: How far the heatmap has been built.

methods.name: heatmap.underPoint
methods.description: The activities whose tracks pass under a point on the heatmap at a whole zoom, grouped by route and by section, newest first, with the figures the phone's sheet shows. A heatmap that is off answers none.

methods.name: status.cache

methods.name: status.coverage

methods.name: status.sync

methods.name: section.includeActivity

methods.name: section.excludeLap

methods.name: section.includeLap
methods.description: Counts one traversal of a section again, addressed by the activity and its start index.

methods.name: section.boundsPreview

methods.name: section.mergePreview

methods.name: route.includeActivity
methods.description: Counts one activity in a route group again.

methods.name: import.begin
methods.description: Starts an import of an archive the page will send, named by name, size and the SHA-256 of its bytes. It answers the id the binary frames carry and how many bytes the phone already holds, so a dropped link sends only the rest.

methods.name: import.commit
methods.description: Commits a begun import into the library.

methods.name: import.cancel
methods.description: Discards a begun import.

methods.name: export.begin
methods.description: Starts writing the library export to a spool on the phone and answers its export id at once. One export builds per device at a time, and a second begin while one builds is refused as busy.

methods.name: export.status
methods.description: How far an export has got: building, ready or failed, its length and rides, and the SHA-256 of the archive once it is ready.

methods.name: export.read
methods.description: Reads up to 1 MiB of a ready export from a byte offset. The answer is binary frames carrying the bytes under the raw flag, not JSON; a failure is a text reply with an error. A read past the end, or on an export still building, is an error.

methods.name: export.done
methods.description: Deletes an export's spool.

methods.name: import.status
methods.description: Where the import job stands and what it has walked: idle, running, done or stopped, with the reason a stopped job gives.

id.description: The intervals.icu athlete id, as `i123`. A number on the wire reads as its digits.

profileMedium.description: The URL of the athlete's medium profile photo.

measurementPreference.description: `meters` or `feet`, the units the athlete chose on intervals.icu.

formAsPercent.description:
Whether the athlete reads form as a share of fitness rather than as
absolute TSB, from `icu_form_as_percent`. Absent on a body from before
the setting existed.

weightKg.description:
The athlete's weight in kilograms: `icu_weight`, which is where the body
sends it, else `weight`. Absent unless positive.

garminSyncsActivities.description:
`icu_garmin_sync_activities`: intervals.icu imports the athlete's Garmin
activities itself.

garminUploadsWorkouts.description: `icu_garmin_upload_workouts`: intervals.icu sends planned workouts to Garmin.

AthleteProfile.description:
The fields of the stored intervals.icu athlete body that the screens and
the widget read, typed once here.

The body is stored as it arrived and carries far more. Each field is read
leniently: missing, `null` or of another type reads as absent and costs the
record nothing else.

Base64.description: A run of bytes as one base64 string; a run of floats is its little-endian bytes.

DisconnectReason.description:
Why the phone ends a connection, which it tells the browser before it
hangs up so the page can say so at once. The farewell line carries it in
camelCase.

EfficiencyDirection.description: Direction of the ratio's trend over matched section efforts.

FfiAbsoluteTarget.description: A relative target converted by the threshold the plan carries.

FfiAbsoluteUnits.description: The unit a relative target converts to.

total.description: Every activity that passes under the point, before the cap.

truncated.description: The cap left some of them out of `groups`.

traceCap.description:
The most traces the map draws for one group under the point, so the
sheet can say how many of a group are drawn. Zero when nothing is under
the point.

groups.description:
One group per route the activities belong to, the biggest first, then
the group of activities in no route.

activities.description:
Every activity the groups list, each once, newest first, without the
grouping. A shared activity is listed here once, where the groups list
it under both.

FfiActivitiesUnderPoint.description: The activities whose tracks pass under a point on the map, grouped by route.

exerciseGroups.description: Exercise groups for this activity, with best sets and rest intervals.

fitnessImpact.description: This activity's addition to the daily fitness, fatigue and form loads.

activityCount.description: Total activities held by the engine

sectionCount.description: Total sections held by the engine

routeGroups.description:
The route group this activity belongs to, if it meets the caller's
minimum. At most one: the screen asks which group holds this activity,
so the catalogue was what it searched rather than what it needed.

representativeSignature.description:
The stored signature of that group's representative activity, delta+varint
encoded: the line the Routes tab draws over the map. Empty when the
activity is in no group or the representative has no signature.

matchedSections.description:
Visible sections this activity traverses, most-visited first.

The light record: the screen draws the line, the name and the counts
and never reads the member list, which on a 30-section activity was
several hundred id strings lifted across JSI on the mount.

customSections.description:
Visible custom sections naming this activity that `matched_sections`
does not already carry. Not the whole custom catalogue: the screen
filtered it to exactly this on the far side of the call.

encounters.description: One entry per (section, direction) this activity encountered

memberships.description:
Every route and visible section this activity matched, with whether the
athlete took it out of that one. The matched lists above leave an
excluded pass out, so this is the only place one still shows.

highlights.description: Section indicators and route highlights for this activity

sectionTraces.description: This activity's portion of every section it matches

prSectionIds.description: Sections where this activity currently holds the best record

maxHr.description:
The max HR this activity's heart rate is read against: the top of its
own zones, then the sport setting for its type, then 190. The stat card
and the zones chart both divide by it.

maxHrSource.description:
Which of those `max_hr` came from, so a screen can tell the athlete's
own maximum from the default.

hrZones.description:
The heart rate zone bands for this activity and the time in each, from
the same resolver live recording classifies with. Empty when the
activity has no heart rate time to show.

summary.description:
The summary stored with the activity, read whether or not its streams
were ever fetched.

powerZones.description:
The power zone bands in watts for this activity and the time in each,
from its own zones and FTP. Empty when the activity has no power zone
time or no zones to place it in.

ledgerChanges.description: Section changes whose ledger rows name this activity, newest first.

intervalsId.description:
The intervals.icu id a web link may name. None for a demo row and for
a recording no server has named, which have no page there.

poolSwim.description:
A pool swim's lengths, rests, SWOLF and per-stroke totals. None for
every sport but `Swim`.

syncFailure.description:
The fault the last sync met readying this activity, which the screen
marks with a retry. None when its last readying was clean.

heldBack.description:
Set when intervals.icu holds this activity but does not serve it to
apps, which is why its figures are empty. None for a served activity.

provenance.description: Where the activity's data was filled from, so the screen can say so.

heatmapHidden.description:
Whether the athlete hid this activity from the heatmap. It stays in
every list, statistic and section and on its own map.

FfiActivityDetailData.description:
All data needed to paint the activity detail screen in one call.
Replaces a fan-out that grew one trace extraction per matched section.

fitnessDays.description: The fitness time constant in days in effect on the activity's date

fatigueDays.description: The fatigue time constant in days in effect on the activity's date

FfiActivityFitnessImpact.description: An activity's contribution against a rest day, before display rounding.

source.description: The service the activity was imported from, as intervals.icu names it.

externalId.description: The id the activity has at that service.

FfiActivityHeldBack.description: An activity intervals.icu holds but does not serve, and where it got it.

newGround.description: Tile coverage against earlier activities, for the activities with any.

strengthCards.description: One row per strength activity among the ids, with what its card paints.

FfiActivityHighlightsBundle.description:
Combined payload for batched activity-list highlights: pre-computed
section indicators (PRs + trends) and route highlights for the same
activity IDs, and the strength cards among them, delivered in a single FFI
round-trip.

label.description: The chip text a feed row shows for this indicator, worded here once.

FfiActivityIndicator.description:
Pre-computed PR or trend indicator for an activity.
Read from the `activity_indicators` table - no on-demand computation.

zone.description: The training zone the server placed a work interval in, from 1.

startTime.description:
Elapsed seconds from the activity start. Index-free, so it survives a
reduction of the streams, which the indices below do not. Every body
measured carries them; the indices place a lap that comes without.

startIndex.description: Positions in the server's own streams.

label.description: The name the athlete gave the interval, when they gave one.

FfiActivityIntervals.description:
An activity's laps, in the order the server sent them. Empty is a fetched
activity with no laps.

sectionName.description: The section's name now, absent when it has none.

kind.description: The ledger kind of the change, as in `FfiSectionHistoryEvent`.

relation.description:
How the row names the activity: around, fork_around, reanchored_from or
reanchored_to.

summary.description:
What the change did to the line and why, as the section's own ledger
reads it. Absent on a row that is not a detector change.

FfiActivityLedgerChange.description:
A ledger row that names one activity, with the section it sits on.

`relation` says how the row names it: `around` and `fork_around` for the
lists a change attributes, `reanchored_from` and `reanchored_to` for the
two ends of a reference re-anchor. None of them says the activity caused
the change.
It is where the activity was around the change, never a cause.

name.description: The name it is shown under, `None` while it has none.

excluded.description:
For a route, the match row's flag. For a section, whether no counted
pass remains: an activity with only some laps excluded is not
excluded, that state is per lap.

FfiActivityMembership.description:
A route or section an activity matched, and whether the athlete excluded
the activity from it.

date.description: Start time as epoch seconds, so a caller can order what it draws.

FfiActivityName.description:
One activity's display name, for a caller that holds ids and has to draw
something an athlete recognises. Only the ids the engine knows are
answered, so the caller falls back to the id itself.

FfiActivityNewGround.description:
How much of an activity's ground no earlier activity had covered, counted
in z17 tiles. It is coverage of a fixed grid, not metres of new road.

FfiActivityProvenance.description: Where an activity's data was filled from, as its screen says it.

id.description: The key the body is stored under, which is the id the screen asked for.

isDetail.description:
Whether the body is the detail form rather than the list row, which
lacks most of the figures below until the detail fetch replaces it.

sportType.description: The sport as the body names it, absent when it names none.

ftp.description: The FTP the activity was scored against, and the eFTP it estimated.

hrRecovery.description: Heart rate recovery, the drop in beats per minute.

decoupling.description:
Aerobic decoupling in percent, `None` when intervals.icu stored no
finite value.

metricsSource.description:
`veloq` when the load, intensity, normalised power, efficiency factor,
decoupling and zone times above were worked out on the phone from the
activity's streams, `None` when intervals.icu supplied them or none
exist.

hasWeather.description: Whether the temperatures below include intervals.icu's weather.

sensorTemp.description: Degrees Celsius from the device's own sensor.

feelsLike.description: Degrees Celsius, from whichever of its names the body carries.

streamTypes.description: The stream kinds intervals.icu holds for the activity.

FfiActivityRecord.description:
One stored activity as the detail screen reads it, typed from the body
intervals.icu sent. A figure the body does not carry is `None`; the three
the screen always draws are zero instead, as a manual entry sends them.

isPr.description: True when this activity's duration is the best across all route attempts

timeDeltaSeconds.description:
Seconds between this activity's moving time and the route PR's moving
time. Negative = ahead of PR, positive = behind PR. None when there is
no PR comparison available (e.g. first attempt).

prImprovementSeconds.description:
When is_pr: seconds faster than the previous best attempt. None when
this is the only timed attempt, when times tie, or when not a PR.

label.description: The chip text a feed row shows for this highlight, worded here once.

FfiActivityRouteHighlight.description: Lightweight route highlight for an activity: was this a PR on the route?

cadence.description: Cadence in the sport's cadence unit, so steps a minute on foot.

gap.description: Grade-adjusted pace in minutes per kilometre.

FfiActivityStreams.description:
An activity's chart series as they cross the bridge: no JSON, no per-value
objects. Every series but `latlng` is its samples as little-endian 64-bit
floats, read through a `Float64Array`, and a gap is NaN. `latlng` is the
engine's one track encoding, unframed. A series the activity does not have
is an empty buffer. All the series share one index space, so sample `i` of
one is sample `i` of every other.

elapsedTime.description: Elapsed time in seconds, pauses and stops included

averageCadence.description:
Average cadence in `cadence_unit`: steps a minute on foot, where
intervals.icu stores strides

cadenceUnit.description: The unit this sport's cadence is shown in, here and in its stream

FfiActivitySummary.description:
The summary intervals.icu stored with an activity. Each field is `None`
when the activity carries no positive value for it.

message.description: What went wrong, as the engine words it.

failedAt.description:
When the attempt failed, in epoch milliseconds, from
[`super::attempts::now_ms`].

FfiActivitySyncFailure.description: The fault a sync last met readying one activity.

edgeSpeeds.description:
A section's speed in m/s over each bin edge, `counts.len() + 1` values,
so the axis is labelled in the scatter's unit. `None` for a route,
whose attempts differ in length and whose scatter plots time. An edge
at zero seconds reads 0.

unbinnedOutsideBand.description:
Route attempts the scatter draws that the bins leave out for lying
outside the distance band. Zero for a section.

FfiAttemptHistogram.description:
Equal-width bins of attempt time. Bin `i` covers
`[start_secs + i * bin_width_secs, start_secs + (i + 1) * bin_width_secs)`
and the last bin is closed.

FfiAttemptHistograms.description:
The counted attempts' times binned for the histogram plot, per direction.
`None` for a direction with fewer than three counted attempts. Excluded
attempts are never in it.

runs.description: The last run of each job that has run on this install.

detectionAwaiting.description:
Stored activities no detect has seen. `None` when it cannot be counted,
which must not read as nothing left to do.

cutoverOwed.description: Whether a section rebuild is still owed.

streamDaysToFinish.description:
Whole days the stream backfill's daily allowance takes to draw what it
owes, when that is more than one day. `None` when the queue fits in a
day, is empty, or cannot be counted.

backfillDayShare.description:
The activities the backfill draws in one budget day, the figure
`stream_days_to_finish` counts against. `None` when it has no daily cap.

garminPull.description: The Garmin pull, `None` while no Garmin key is held.

downloadsHeldUntilMs.description:
When the elevation and stream downloads may next be asked again, in
epoch milliseconds, while a refusal's cooldown or the request budget
holds them. `None` when nothing holds them.

downloadsHeldCause.description: Who asked for that wait. `None` when nothing holds them.

dailyLimit.description:
What the backfill has drawn of today's allowance and when it resets.
`None` where the governor only paces.

passRecountRunning.description: Whether the one-time pass recount is running on its own thread now.

stagedHistory.description:
How much of the library at the staged cut has its elevation decided,
while older activities are still joining. `None` once the counts are
written, and for a library that never staged.

FfiBackgroundJobsData.description:
What the background jobs have done and still owe, read once each time a job
settles or activities land. The running progress is not here: it moves on
every item and stays on the routes status poll.

notRestored.description:
History rows the latest restore left in its backup file because no
section here covers their ground.

namesNotRestored.description:
Route names the latest restore gave up on because the grouping here
merged their routes into one that already took a restored name.

recordBackupRun.description:
The running record backup's id, for `cancel_run`, or nothing running.
Read from the job, not the database: a backup is single-flight.

checkpoint.description: Seconds for power, metres for pace.

value.description:
Watts for power, metres per second for pace. Empty when the curve
holds no sample within tolerance of the checkpoint.

time.description: Seconds taken to cover the distance, for pace only.

wattsPerKg.description: Watts per kilogram for power, from the curve's own per-kilogram series.

wkgActivityId.description:
The activity holding the per-kilogram best, which need not be the one
holding the watts.

activity.description:
The name and start of the activity holding the best, when the device
holds that activity. Empty for one it does not, which the screen shows
as not cached.

FfiBestEffortKind.description:
What a best effort's checkpoint measures. The front end words it in the
athlete's language and units, so the engine sends no display string.

sports.description: Ride power, then Run and Swim pace.

climbing.description: The Ride and Run climbing families.

FfiBestEffortsData.description: Everything the Best Efforts screen paints with, over one period.

fetched.description:
False when the curve for this period was never fetched, which is the
cue to ask for it. Every value is then empty.

FfiBestEffortsSport.description: One sport's bests at the screen's checkpoints, read from its stored curve.

kind.description:
The reason's serde tag: usage_change, fork, traffic_cliff, trim,
low_support, terminus, pass_end or seam_clip.

clippedMetres.description:
How much of the drawn line a seam clip took off, in metres; absent on
every other reason.

FfiBoundaryReason.description: One reason the detector gave for where a section's line was cut.

originalStoreBytes.description: Bytes the kept originals take, deflated, as the originals owner counts them.

FfiCadenceUnit.description: The unit a sport's cadence is shown in.

count.description: Number of traversals in this direction

FfiCalendarDirectionBest.description: Best performance in one direction for a calendar period.

traversalCount.description: Total traversals in this month (both directions), one per lap

activityCount.description: Distinct activities those traversals came from

forward.description: Best forward/same direction performance (None if no forward traversals)

reverse.description: Best reverse direction performance (None if no reverse traversals)

FfiCalendarMonthSummary.description: Best performance in a calendar month, split by direction.

forwardPr.description: The forward record's outing, absent when no outing holds the record

reversePr.description: The reverse record's outing, absent when no outing holds the record

FfiCalendarSummary.description: Calendar-aligned performance summary for a section.

traversalCount.description: Total traversals in this year, one per lap

activityCount.description: Distinct activities those traversals came from

forward.description: Best forward/same direction performance this year

reverse.description: Best reverse direction performance this year

months.description: Monthly breakdowns (only months with traversals, sorted 1-12)

FfiCalendarYearSummary.description: Best performance in a calendar year, with monthly breakdown.

FfiCatalogueEmptyReason.description:
Why a routes or sections catalogue is empty, so the list states its cause
rather than promising rows that cannot come.

metres.description: Metres a trim removed or a seam clip shortened.

neighbour.description: The neighbouring section the record names, with its standing now.

FfiChangeReason.description:
One boundary record, reduced to its counts. `count` of `of` is the share
of the line's rides the record names: the rides that turn back, leave or
take the branch out of the rides through the join. A low-support reason
carries the support floor in `of` and no `count`.

baseline.description:
What the reading is compared with, as a key a surface translates:
`earlierReading` is the newest reading at least `lookback_days` before it.

population.description: The earlier readings inside the window.

FfiClaimBasis.description:
What a trend or verdict was measured against and how much evidence stood
behind it, so a surface can state the method and the engine can withhold a
claim its evidence cannot carry (`crate::claim`).

vam.description: Vertical metres per hour. Empty when no activity measured the window.

activity.description:
The name and start of the activity holding the best, when the device
holds that activity.

owed.description: Activities in the period whose climb rows are still being computed.

sourceExcluded.description:
Activities in the period holding climb rows whose elevation is not the
corrected series, so they are left out of the bests.

bests.description: One per stored window length, shortest first.

FfiClimbBests.description: A climbing family's best window per stored length.

FfiCorrelation.description:
A correlation, or the reason there is none. An enum so a coefficient cannot
be read off a state that has none.

hidden.description: Disabled, or hidden behind the section `superseded_by` names.

FfiCurrentMapSection.description:
A catalogue row as the old-versus-new map draws it, hidden rows included.
A row whose line will not decode has nothing to draw and is left out.

FfiCurveActivity.description: An activity a curve point came from, as the body names it.

used.description: Requests the backfill has drawn in this budget day.

perDay.description: The backfill's requests for a budget day.

resetsAtMs.description: When this install's daily count next resets.

FfiDailyLimit.description:
What the backfill has drawn of its daily allowance, as the sync settings
show it. Instants are epoch milliseconds, the unit the background jobs read
uses.

total.description: Sum of the recorded loads, absent when none is recorded.

activityCount.description: Activities on the day, loaded or not.

FfiDayLoad.description: One local calendar day's recorded activity training load.

FfiDayLoadStatus.description: Whether a local day's recorded activity load can be totalled.

FfiDecouplingSource.description:
The newest cycling activity of half an hour or more with power, heart rate
and a finite decoupling stored by intervals.icu, and that value.

FfiDepartedRide.description:
A ride a section edit took out of the section: its library name and its
start as seconds since the epoch.

FfiDetectionHold.description: What is refusing a detect that is owed.

laps.description:
Oldest first. The reference is among them, level with itself, when it
is inside the range.

missing.description: Laps inside the range that could not be drawn, and why.

peakDeltaSecs.description:
The largest number of seconds any of `laps` is behind or ahead of the
reference, 0 when none has a finite delta.

splitSummary.description:
The typical lap's time against the reference per split, over the laps
other than the reference. `None` when no split has enough laps.

typicalDeltaSecs.description:
The typical lap's delta at each grid point, the median over the laps
other than the reference that reach it. NaN at a point fewer laps
reach than a typical lap needs, and `None` when no point has enough.

previousRecord.description:
The lap that held the record before the current one, measured against
the reference like every lap, whatever the range. `None` when the
record has never been beaten or that lap has no curve.

defaultReference.description:
The reference the chart opens on for the highlighted attempt: the
athlete's own when set, else the record, else the previous record when
the highlighted attempt is the record and so level with itself.

FfiDirectionDeltas.description:
One direction's laps measured against its reference, on an axis running
in the direction of travel.

avgTime.description: Average time across counted traversals in this direction (seconds)

lastActivity.description: Unix timestamp of most recent traversal in this direction

count.description: Number of traversals in this direction

avgSpeed.description: Counted distance over counted time in this direction (m/s).

outsideBandCount.description: Timed route attempts outside the distance band, absent from the averages.

avgHr.description: Average heart rate during this traversal

hrPaceRatio.description:
Heart rate per unit of speed: avg_hr * pace_secs_per_km. Lower is
fewer beats for the same speed, which is more efficient.

FfiEfficiencyPoint.description:
A single data point for aerobic efficiency tracking.
Represents one section traversal with pace and heart rate data.

sportType.description:
The sport the trend was taken over: efforts of other sports on the
section are not in it

points.description: Individual data points sorted by date (oldest first)

trendSlope.description: Linear regression slope of the ratio over time (negative = improving)

direction.description: Direction of the ratio's significant movement.

hrChangeBpm.description:
The ratio's own change over the observed range, restated in bpm at the
mean pace. Not a measured heart rate delta: an effort set that only
changed pace moves it too.

effortCount.description: Efforts the regression used: both signals present and a plausible pace

signalDelta.description:
The newest effort's ratio against the mean of the series, in the
series' own standard deviations. Absent where the series has no spread
to measure against.

FfiEfficiencyTrend.description:
Tracks how heart rate per unit of speed changes over time across matched
section efforts. A declining ratio indicates improving aerobic efficiency
(Coyle et al., J Appl Physiol, 1991; Jones & Carter, Sports Med, 2000).

eftp.description: The accepted eFTP after the activity, in watts.

delta.description: What the activity moved it by, with its sign.

FfiEftpChange.description:
One activity that moved the athlete's accepted eFTP.

The estimate an activity produced is not a change: only a non-zero delta on
the rolling value is, which is what intervals.icu marks on its own plot.

FfiExerciseContribution.description:
Per-exercise contribution to a muscle group, aggregated across all active
sets of one activity. Role reflects whether the muscle is primary or
secondary for the exercise.

FfiExerciseDetailData.description: The sessions and estimated one-rep-max trend for one exercise category.

restSeconds.description: Rest after each preceding active set, when both timestamps are known.

FfiExerciseGroup.description: Consecutive active sets of one exercise within a session.

FfiExerciseHistorySession.description: One session of an exercise, with its heaviest active set.

FfiExercisePickerData.description: The exercise picker: the narrowed list and the vocabulary its filters use.

displayName.description: The English name; a translation is looked up by `label_key`.

lastDoneDays.description: Whole days since the athlete last did it, `None` when never.

usuallyNext.description: It has followed the exercise just done in the athlete's sessions.

FfiExercisePickerRow.description: One exercise in the picker's list.

sets.description: Every stored set, rest and warmup included, in recorded order.

groups.description: Active sets grouped by consecutive exercise name, in recorded order.

exerciseCount.description: Distinct exercise names among the active sets.

totalVolumeKg.description:
Weight times repetitions over active sets. A set with no repetitions
counts as one and a set with no weight as zero.

FfiExerciseSession.description: One session's stored sets with the totals every surface shows for it.

displayName.description: Human-readable exercise name, pre-resolved in Rust.

FfiExerciseSet.description: A single exercise set from a FIT file, exposed to TypeScript.

exerciseCategory.description: FIT exercise category ID (pass back for drill-down query)

totalSets.description: Sets credited to this muscle across all activities

volumeKg.description: Total volume load in kg (weight × reps)

activityCount.description: Number of distinct activities containing this exercise

isPrimary.description: True if the muscle is a primary target for at least one occurrence

FfiExerciseSummary.description: Exercise summary for a specific muscle group within a date range.

FfiFamilyHours.description: Moving hours in one sport family.

id.description:
The row key the body is stored under. A route or a fetch names the
activity by this, never by the body's own `id`, which for an uploaded
recording is the server's id rather than the row's.

intervalsWebId.description:
The intervals.icu id a web link may name. None for a demo row and for
a recording no server has named.

sportType.description: The sport as the body carries it. None when it names none.

name.description: Empty when the body has none.

startDateLocal.description:
The wall-clock start as the body carries it, with no zone. Empty when
the body has none.

metricsSource.description:
`veloq` when `training_load` was worked out on the phone from the
activity's streams, `None` otherwise.

skylineChartBytes.description: The elevation skyline as intervals.icu encodes it, base64.

hasGps.description: Whether the activity recorded a `latlng` stream.

hasAltitude.description:
Whether the activity recorded an `altitude` stream, which makes a zero
climb a measurement rather than a missing one.

syncFailure.description:
The fault the last sync met readying this activity, which the card
marks with a retry. None when its last readying was clean.

stub.description:
Whether the activity is a stub intervals.icu does not serve, and what
the card offers for it.

heatmapHidden.description:
Whether the athlete hid the activity from the heatmap. The detail
record carries the same flag; a list that offers a bulk hide marks the
rows it hid from this one.

FfiFeedCard.description:
What one feed card draws, typed from the stored body.

Built from the body rather than `activity_metrics`, which files a body
with no sport as a ride and keeps heart rate and power as whole numbers.

oldestTs.description: Epoch seconds of the earliest stored start.

newestTs.description: Epoch seconds of the latest stored start.

minDistance.description: Metres, over the activities with a positive distance.

maxDistance.description: Metres, over the activities with a positive distance.

minMovingTime.description: Seconds, over the activities with a positive moving time.

maxMovingTime.description: Seconds, over the activities with a positive moving time.

FfiFeedFilterBounds.description:
The span of the library the feed's filter bars draw across: the first and
last start, and the shortest and longest distance and moving time. Every
field is absent when nothing answers it, so an empty library draws no bar.

The dates reach every stored activity. A distance or a time bound takes
only the positive values, so a session with neither (a strength session,
say) does not pull a minimum to zero.

FfiFeedSort.description:
A column and a direction. A row with no value in the column comes last
whichever way it runs.

FfiFeedSortKey.description: The column a feed read orders by.

ftpTrend.description:
The cycling eFTP compared across the chart's three months, with the
daily series of that window and every activity that moved it.

ftpTrendCoverage.description:
Whether the wellness the trend is read from was pulled for the days
its chart draws. `NotFetched` makes an empty chart a download still
owed rather than an athlete with no estimate.

runPaceTrend.description:
The last stored critical speeds, the threshold the running and
swimming cards fall back on when no curve is to hand.

sportMix.description:
The rides, runs and swims among the latest activities, which the
primary sport defaults to until the athlete chooses one.

fitnessDays.description: The fitness time constant in days in effect today

fatigueDays.description: The fatigue time constant in days in effect today

cyclingFtpSetting.description:
The cycling FTP the athlete set, in watts, else the one the newest
cycling activity was analysed against.

runningLthr.description: The running LTHR the athlete set, in bpm.

decouplingSources.description: The decoupling ride of each span the read was asked for, in that order.

loadDots.description:
Every activity inside the longest span asked for, oldest first, for the
strip under the fitness plot.

loadTrend.description:
The least-squares line through `load_dots` by day, which the strip's
scatter draws. Absent for fewer than two dots or dots on one day.

weeklyHours.description:
Moving hours per week and sport family over the twelve weeks ending at
the latest week that holds an activity, oldest first. A week with
nothing in it stays in the series with no hours. It does not follow the
spans the read was asked for.

heatmap.description:
Days with activities from `calendar_first_day` to the window's last
day, oldest first.

calendarFirstDay.description:
The calendar's first drawn day, `YYYY-MM-DD`: the Monday of the latest
of the held window's oldest day and the account's oldest activity, and
never before the window's first day, which is the calendar's cap.

calendarOlderOwed.description:
The activities from the cap to the day before `calendar_first_day`
that the account holds and the device has not downloaded.

months.description: Calendar months with activities inside the monthly span, oldest first.

seasonYear.description: The year to date against the same span of last year.

seasonMonths.description:
Each month of this year to date against the same month a year before,
January first: the months before this one whole, then this month to
date against the same span of last year's.

comparisons.description: The weekly card's periods to now, each against the same span before.

uncountedImports.description:
The imported rides the server's figures leave out: shown as rides, and
in no curve, best effort or fitness day. Zero for a Garmin-only library.

FfiFitnessScreenData.description:
Everything the fitness tab paints with that stays fixed while it is
mounted, its calendar, weekly card and year comparison among it. Its sport
is chosen with a tap, so the reads over it are their own; the parts that
follow the range carry every span, and the weekly card every range, so a
tap reads nothing.

heatmapFirstDay.description:
The first day the heatmap may draw, its cap, and its last drawn day,
`YYYY-MM-DD`, inclusive. The read answers the first day it draws.

months.description: The span the monthly rows cover.

yearCurrent.description: The year to date, and the same span of last year.

monthCurrent.description: The month to date, and the same span of the month a year before.

nowWallSeconds.description:
The instant the weekly card's periods run to, in the wall-clock seconds
an activity's date is recorded in.

FfiFitnessScreenWindows.description:
The windows the fitness tab's calendar, week and year cards draw, each
fixed for as long as it stays mounted. The front end names them because
its grid and its season cards lay out the same days.

FfiFocusNeighbour.description: A neighbouring exercise, shown small beside the current one.

FfiFocusPhase.description: Where the session is, as the athlete would say it.

slowCount.description: Points drawn past the slow end.

fastCount.description: Points drawn past the fast end.

FfiFocusRange.description:
The range a direction's scatter axis draws, in the axis's own unit: metres
per second on a section, seconds on a route.

setNumber.description: One-based, so a screen can say "set 2 of 3".

displayWeight.description: The weight as the athlete reads it, in `weight_unit`, to one decimal.

weightStep.description: One tap of the weight stepper, in `weight_unit`.

weightDownKg.description: The stored kilograms after one tap down and one tap up; an unset weight steps from zero.

FfiFocusSet.description: The set to do, with its place in its exercise.

restStartedAt.description: Epoch seconds the running rest began.

restEndsAt.description: Epoch seconds the running rest ends.

FfiFocusState.description: What the focus view and the lock screen show of the live session.

latestFtp.description: eFTP of the newest day carrying one

previousFtp.description:
eFTP of the newest day on or before `lookback_days` earlier than
`latest_date`. It may equal `latest_ftp`

deltaWatts.description:
The step from `previous_ftp` to `latest_ftp` in watts, with its sign.
Derived here so a screen, a widget and a notification cannot each
subtract and round their own way. `None` when there is nothing to
compare against.

glyph.description:
The arrow the step draws, judged by [`crate::trend_table::glyph`]: up
for a gain, flat inside the deadband, `None` when there is nothing to
compare against.

lookbackDays.description:
The window in days `delta_watts` was measured across, carried so a
caption names the window of the step it shows rather than the range of
the chart it sits on, which can be longer.

sampleCount.description:
Days carrying an estimate from the one compared against to the newest,
inclusive. The insight ranker weighs a claim by what it stands on, and
a step measured off three days is not the one measured off thirty.

history.description:
The daily estimates the step was read from, oldest first. The same
series `sample_count` counts, carried rather than counted, so the
milestone card draws the run-up to the step it names.

historyDays.description:
Beside `history`, one per point: the day it is the estimate of,
`YYYY-MM-DD`. The points are stamped at midnight UTC of that day, so a
page reads the day here and does not convert the stamp to a local one.

changes.description:
Every activity that moved the accepted eFTP, oldest first, whatever the
window: the fitness plot marks them over its own range.

FfiFtpTrend.description:
Cycling FTP trend, read from the daily cycling eFTP in the `sportInfo`
entries of `wellness.raw`, not from the configured FTP setting (`icu_ftp`)
or the per-activity estimate (`icu_pm_ftp_watts`). The latest and previous
values are days of that series and are not activity starts.

resumeAt.description: Milliseconds since the epoch that a paused pass resumes at.

stored.description: Originals this device has stored from Garmin.

reachedMonth.description: The earliest month the history pull has finished, as `YYYY-MM`.

backfillDone.description: Whether the history pull has passed the oldest ride.

FfiGarminPull.description: The Garmin pull's count, month and terminal state, for the settings screen.

FfiGroupSort.description:
The order the routes list is in. `Nearby` is the engine's own distance
ranking, which is why the order is an argument rather than something the
list redoes after it has been paged.

distanceMeters.description: Distance in meters (from representative activity's metrics)

sportTypes.description: All sport types present in this group's activities

bestTime.description:
Moving time in seconds of the fastest attempt not excluded from the
route, `None` when no attempt has a time.

FfiGroupWithPolyline.description:
Group summary with the representative polyline for the Routes screen.
Avoids N separate getRepresentativeRoute() calls.

maxDuration.description: Longest activity duration in seconds for this day

activityCount.description: Number of activities on this day

FfiHeatmapDay.description: Pre-computed daily activity intensity for the activity heatmap.

FfiHoldCause.description:
Who asked for a hold on the downloads, named in the order the engine
decides it.

minBpm.description: Lower edge in bpm, 0 for zone 1

percent.description: Share of the total time in zones, 0 to 100

share.description: The share as a whole percent, the bands' shares totalling 100

FfiHrZoneBand.description: One heart rate zone of a saved activity.

reason.description:
Which rule produced `label`: `halves` for the window's two halves
moving apart by more than their own scatter, `lastTwoDays` for the
override fired by two consecutive readings below the window mean and
apart from the readings before them. Both can say
`trendingDown` and they are not the same claim.

windowSplit.description:
Epoch seconds where the later half of the window starts, the split the
`halves` rule judged. Absent for `lastTwoDays`, which judges no split.

signalDelta.description:
The latest day against the window's average, in the window's own
standard deviations. Absent where the window has no spread.

FfiHrvTrend.description:
HRV trend summary over a trailing window. `label` is the i18n key suffix
("trendingUp" | "stable" | "trendingDown") - TS resolves translations.

FfiImprovementBasis.description: What an improvement change was measured between.

date.description: The day the reading is from, `YYYY-MM-DD`

ctl.description: Chronic training load, zero when the day carries none

atl.description: Acute training load, zero when the day carries none

form.description:
Form in the unit the athlete reads it in, as `FfiWellnessDays::form`
gives it for the same day.

formAsPercent.description: Whether `form` is a percentage of fitness rather than absolute TSB.

FfiInsightForm.description:
Fitness and fatigue, as the newest day in the window has them.

The two were derived per recompute by sorting the window's rows, over rows
that had crossed the boundary only to be reduced to these. The day is carried so a stale reading can be named rather than
passed off as today's.

chronicPeriod.description: 4-week chronic period stats (raw total, not averaged)

chronicWeekAverage.description:
`chronic_period` over the four weeks it is divided into, which is what
a week is compared against.

weeklyTotals.description:
The four chronic weeks and then the compared week, one at a time,
oldest first and each dated. The comparison card's claim is about the
last four weeks, and two totals cannot draw it. The first four sum to
`chronic_period`.

recentPrs.description: Up to 3 recent section PRs (best times set in last 7 days)

sectionCount.description: Sections held by the engine, for the section-readiness check

sportTypes.description: Sport types the ranked-section lists were built for

rankedSections.description: ranked sections per sport, empty when sections were not requested

trendSections.description: Every eligible section trend, independent of the ranked-list display limit.

routeInsights.description:
Every route bucket holding a recent record or an eligible trend, recent
records first and then newest attempt. Not capped.

efficiencyTrends.description: Aerobic efficiency trends worth surfacing, already filtered and capped

strengthSeries.description: Strength volume over the requested month and weeks, when data exists

form.description:
Form as the newest day in the requested wellness window has it, or
`None` when the window holds no day at all

weekOverWeek.description:
This week against last, absent when neither total gives the earlier
week something to divide by.

weekAgainstChronic.description: Last week against the chronic weekly average, on the same terms.

hrvTrend.description: HRV over the trailing window, or `None` under five valid days

hrvWithheldSince.description:
The date of the newest stored wellness row when `hrv_trend` is absent
because the window is stale. `None` when the window is fresh or no
wellness was ever synced.

recentSectionChanges.description: Re-cuts, splits, restores and reverts inside the requested window

stalePrOpportunities.description:
Sections a fitness gain makes worth revisiting, already excluding the
ones `recent_prs` covers

FfiInsightsData.description:
Batch insights data: combines period stats, trends, patterns, and recent PRs.
Reduces Insights hook FFI calls from 13-16 to 1.

currentStart.description: Start of the current week, filled by the engine from current_end

currentEnd.description: Current wall-clock second; the engine derives both week windows from it

prevStart.description: Start of the previous week, filled by the engine

prevEnd.description: End of the previous elapsed week, filled by the engine

chronicStart.description: Start of the four-week chronic window, filled by the engine

includeSections.description: Whether section-derived insights are wanted at all

historyLimit.description:
History points a card carries at most, per section and per trend. The
graphic is a strip a few dozen pixels wide, so the read is capped
rather than carrying a library of laps across the bridge.

activeWindowDays.description: Sections last visited beyond this many days get no efficiency trend

efficiencyPerSport.description: Efficiency candidates taken from each sport's ranked list

efficiencyMinHrChangeBpm.description: Smallest rounded heart-rate change, in bpm, an efficiency trend may report

efficiencyLimit.description: Efficiency trends to return at most

efficiencyMinEfforts.description: Minimum matched efforts before an efficiency trend counts

strengthMonth.description: Trailing month the strength summary covers

strengthWeeks.description: Trailing weeks the strength summary covers

wellnessOldest.description: Oldest day of the wellness window form is read from, `YYYY-MM-DD`

wellnessNewest.description: Newest day of it, which is normally today in the athlete's own zone

hrvWindowDays.description: Trailing days the HRV trend is read over

sectionChangeWindowDays.description: Trailing days the section-change list covers

staleThresholdDays.description: A section unvisited for this many days is stale

staleMinGainPercent.description: Fitness has to have risen by this much for a stale section to qualify

staleMaxOpportunities.description: Stale-PR opportunities to return at most

staleMinTraversals.description: Fewest traversals a stale section needs to be offered

recentPrWindowDays.description: A section record counts as recent when set within this many days

recentPrMinOutings.description: Fewest outings a section needs to hold a recent-record slot

FfiInsightsParams.description: Scalar inputs for the insights bundle.

FfiIntervalKind.description: What an interval is, as intervals.icu labels it.

job.description: detection, elevationBackfill, streamBackfill, cutover or passRecount.

finishedAt.description:
When the run finished, in epoch milliseconds, from
[`super::attempts::now_ms`].

outcome.description: complete, partial, failed, paused, stopped or deferred.

FfiJobRun.description: One job's last run. A job leaves at zero the counts it has no measure of.

startIndex.description: Joins the curve to its chart point and lap row.

deltaSecs.description:
Seconds behind the reference (positive) or ahead of it (negative) at
each grid point from the start of travel, zero at the first shared point and
NaN outside the covered range.

splitDeltaSecs.description:
The change in delta over each split, in travel order. NaN for a split
the lap does not fully cover.

splitSecs.description:
The lap's own seconds over each split, on the split grid of
`split_delta_secs`. NaN for a split the lap does not fully cover.

endDeltaSecs.description:
The delta at the end of the section, only for a lap that covers both
of its ends.

FfiLapDelta.description: One lap's time against the reference along the section.

FfiLapDeltaMissing.description: A lap inside the range with no curve.

FfiLapDeltaMissingReason.description: Why a lap in range has no delta curve.

FfiLinkActivityAsk.description: What a method that reads one activity is asked.

FfiLinkActivityIntervals.description:
What `activity.intervals` answers: the laps, or none when the body was
never fetched or will not parse.

FfiLinkActivityRecord.description:
What `activity.record` answers: the stored body typed as the detail screen
reads it, or none when nothing is stored.

FfiLinkActivitySections.description:
What `activity.sections` answers: the visible custom sections that name
the activity.

FfiLinkBestEffortsAsk.description: What `fitness.bestEfforts` is asked: a window in days, where 0 is all time.

FfiLinkBoundsEdit.description: The edits `section.editBounds` makes to a section's line.

FfiLinkBoundsPreview.description:
What `section.boundsPreview` answers: the distance and grade the section
would store after the same `trim` or `expand`, read from the line the edit
would write, and the laps the edit re-cuts against it. The grade is null
when the line carries no altitude.

FfiLinkClient.description:
What a client says it is in `link.hello`: a browser sends its user agent,
a computer tool its name and version. The phone shows it as the client's
own claim, never as verified.

total.description: The sum of the days' recorded loads, a day with none adding nothing.

FfiLinkDayLoads.description: What `fitness.loads` answers: a load for each day with activities.

FfiLinkDetectionEnabledAsk.description: What `detection.setEnabled` is asked: whether route matching is on.

FfiLinkDetectionSettings.description:
What `detection.settings` answers: the switch, the match strictness and the
section config, each as the engine reads it.

FfiLinkDevicesAnswer.description:
What `status.linkedDevices` answers: every linked device and the id of the
one that asked.

FfiLinkDraftExercise.description:
One exercise of a workout: the FIT category and name pair, the group it is
done with, the rest after it and its sets.

FfiLinkDraftGroup.description: The rest planned after a group of exercises.

FfiLinkDraftSet.description:
One set of a workout as the builder holds it: what the athlete means to
do, with the optional side and warm-up behind the set's "more".

FfiLinkExcludeAsk.description:
What the exclude and include methods are asked: the section or route and
the activity.

FfiLinkExerciseAsk.description: What `strength.exercise` is asked: the exercise category.

since.description:
Keep the rides that start at this Unix time or later; the record and the
library tables are written whole whatever this says.

originals.description: Write each ride's kept original file as well as its rows.

FfiLinkExportBeginAsk.description: What `export.begin` is asked: which rides the library export carries.

FfiLinkExportBegun.description: What `export.begin` answers: the id of the spool the export is written to.

FfiLinkExportBytes.description:
What `export.read` answers: not JSON. The reply is binary frames carrying
the bytes of the range under [`FRAME_RAW`], and a failure is a text reply
with an `error`. The record names the one field that describes the frames.

offset.description: Bytes from the start of the archive, a whole number below 2^53.

length.description: At most 1 MiB, a whole number.

FfiLinkExportReadAsk.description: What `export.read` is asked: a range of the finished archive.

FfiLinkExportRef.description: What `export.status` and `export.done` are asked: which export.

FfiLinkExportStatus.description:
What `export.status` answers. `state` is `building`, `ready` or `failed`.
`bytes` is the archive's length once it is ready and what is written so far
before, and `sha256` is the lowercase hex digest of the ready archive.

FfiLinkFamilyCount.description: One sport family and how many stored activities fall in it.

matchedCount.description: Every stored activity the query matched, not only this page.

previews.description: One per card with GPS and a stored track; a card with none is absent.

familyCounts.description:
Stored activities per sport family under the ask's search and window,
whatever families it names, so a chip counts what it would add. A
family with none is absent.

rows.description: The lean rows of a lean ask, in the order of the cards they replace.

FfiLinkFeedPage.description:
What `feed.page` answers: the feed read the phone's own list draws, and the
preview line of each card on it that has a stored track.

The lines are the phone card's own (`get_preview_track`), so the browser
never simplifies a track itself, and they ride with the page so a row
never waits on a second ask.

limit.description: None asks for the largest page the phone allows.

oldestTs.description: Inclusive start time in epoch seconds; None reaches the oldest.

newestTs.description: Inclusive start time in epoch seconds; None reaches the newest.

minDistance.description: Inclusive lower bound on distance in metres; None is unbounded.

maxDistance.description: Inclusive upper bound on distance in metres; None is unbounded.

minMovingTime.description: Inclusive lower bound on moving time in seconds; None is unbounded.

maxMovingTime.description: Inclusive upper bound on moving time in seconds; None is unbounded.

sort.description:
The order of the whole match before the page is cut; None is newest
first.

lean.description: Answer `rows` in place of cards and previews.

FfiLinkFeedPageAsk.description:
What `feed.page` is asked: a window of the feed, narrowed by a search, a
set of sport families and a span of start times, as the phone's own filter
chips narrow it.

FfiLinkFitnessScreenAsk.description:
What `fitness.screen` is asked: the spans the decoupling ride and the
strip's activities are read for, and the windows the calendar, the weekly
card and the year comparison are read over.

FfiLinkGeoGroupAsk.description: What `geo.route`, `geo.routeLatest` and `geo.routeAttempts` are asked: one route group.

FfiLinkGeoSectionAsk.description: What `geo.section` and `geo.sectionPasses` are asked: one section.

maxPoints.description:
Cap the line to at most this many points, first and last kept. Absent or zero keeps it
whole.

packed.description: Answer the line as `packedLine`, one integer array, in place of GeoJSON text.

FfiLinkGeoSectionLineAsk.description:
What `geo.section` is asked: one section, and how its line comes back. With neither field the
reply is the GeoJSON it has always been.

version.description: A version number from `section.history`'s geometry versions.

FfiLinkGeoSectionVersionAsk.description: What `geo.sectionVersion` is asked: one stored geometry version of one section.

packedLine.description:
The line as one integer array, when the ask was `packed`: then `text` is empty. See
[`pack_line`](crate::persistence::codec::pack_line) for the layout.

FfiLinkGroupsAsk.description: What `strength.groups` is asked: the phone's wall clock in seconds.

FfiLinkHeatmapHiddenAsk.description:
What `heatmap.setHidden` is asked: the activity and whether the heatmap
leaves it out.

FfiLinkHeatmapHiddenManyAsk.description:
What `heatmap.setHiddenMany` is asked: the activities and whether the
heatmap leaves them all out. The write is one change: every id takes the
choice or none does.

FfiLinkHeatmapProgress.description:
What `heatmap.progress` answers: the tiles the pass has drawn of the tiles
it owes, both 0 while no pass runs.

FfiLinkHeatmapTile.description:
What `heatmap.tile` answers: the PNG, or `None` for a tile with no heat or
one the pass has not drawn yet.

FfiLinkHeatmapTileAsk.description: What `heatmap.tile` is asked: one tile and the base map it is painted for.

FfiLinkHeatmapUnderPointAsk.description:
What `heatmap.underPoint` is asked: the point clicked and the whole zoom
the page's camera is at.

client.description: What the client says it is, when it says.

FfiLinkHello.description:
What `link.hello` is asked: the newest protocol the page speaks, the
oldest when it speaks more than one, and a name for the page. A page that
names no oldest speaks `protocol` alone.

FfiLinkHelloAnswer.description:
What `link.hello` answers: the protocol the two will speak (the phone's own
newest when the ranges do not meet), the phone's range, the app version,
the name of every method it answers, and the name of the phone when it has
one. The name is optional, so a page reads an answer without it.

FfiLinkHighlightsAsk.description: What `feed.highlights` is asked: the cards a page shows, at most one page.

FfiLinkImportBeginAsk.description:
What `import.begin` is asked: the archive the page will send, by name,
size and the SHA-256 of its bytes in lowercase hex.

FfiLinkImportBegun.description:
What `import.begin` answers: the id the binary frames carry, and how many
bytes of this archive the phone already holds, so a page whose link dropped
sends only the rest.

FfiLinkImportCommitted.description:
What `import.commit` answers once the import job has the archive. There is
one importer at a time, so the job is named by the import that started it.

FfiLinkImportFailure.description: A file the import job could not make a ride of.

FfiLinkImportRef.description: What `import.commit` and `import.cancel` are asked: which import.

FfiLinkImportStatus.description:
What `import.status` answers: where the import job stands and what it has
walked. `state` is `idle`, `running`, `done` or `stopped`, and a stopped
job says why in `stopped`: `cancelled`, `unreadable` or `unstorable`.

FfiLinkLapAsk.description:
What `section.excludeLap` and `section.includeLap` are asked: the
traversal, addressed by the activity and its start index.

daysAgo.description: Whole days from that session to now.

FfiLinkLastTime.description: An exercise as the latest session that did it left it.

FfiLinkLastTimeAnswer.description: What `strength.lastTime` answers: `None` for an exercise never done.

FfiLinkLastTimeAsk.description:
What `strength.lastTime` is asked: one exercise and the phone's wall clock
in seconds.

FfiLinkLeanRow.description:
One activity as a client that does not draw cards reads it: the fields of
the card a list or a ranking needs, built from the card itself.

FfiLinkLiveAnswer.description:
What `strength.live` answers: the session being recorded and what the focus
view shows of it, both `None` when no session is live.

FfiLinkLiveEditAsk.description:
What `strength.liveEdit` is asked: the one change the phone's own recorder
makes, in the athlete's unit.

FfiLinkLoadsAsk.description: What `fitness.loads` is asked: an inclusive window of wall-clock seconds.

FfiLinkMapAsk.description:
What `map.screen` is asked: the phone's map filters. The date window is in
epoch seconds, as the phone reads it; an empty `sportTypes` keeps every sport.

routeGeneration.description:
The route group generation the route-line layer is built from; `None`
while there is no layer.

sectionStamp.description:
The database state the section layer is read in; `None` when the read
cannot vouch for one.

FfiLinkMapScreen.description:
What `map.screen` answers: the phone's map read without its line layers,
and the revisions of the two layers the page fetches by URL, so a filter
change that leaves a layer alone refetches nothing.

FfiLinkMergeAsk.description:
What `section.mergePreview` and `section.merge` are asked: the section kept
and the one merged into it.

FfiLinkMergePreview.description:
What `section.mergePreview` answers: the rides a merge would leave out of
the kept section, and the laps it measures on the kept line for the rides
it takes in.

FfiLinkMuscleAsk.description:
What `strength.muscle` is asked: one activity and the muscle the diagram
was tapped on.

maxPoints.description: Cap each line to at most this many points. Absent or zero keeps the read's default.

packed.description: Carry each line as `packedLine` in place of `encodedCoords`.

FfiLinkNearbyAsk.description:
What `nearby.places` is asked: the point and sport, the route followed, and how each line
comes back.

FfiLinkNearbyPlaces.description: The routes and sections near a point, nearest first.

FfiLinkNoAsk.description: What a read that takes nothing is asked.

FfiLinkPaceCurve.description:
What `fitness.paceCurve` answers: the stored curve, or none when it was
never fetched.

FfiLinkPaceCurveAsk.description:
What `fitness.paceCurve` is asked: a sport, a window in days and whether the
pace is grade adjusted.

FfiLinkPerformanceAsk.description:
What `route.performance` and `section.performance` are asked: the route or
section, how many days back the range reaches, the sport and the activity
to mark.

FfiLinkPickerAsk.description:
What `strength.picker` is asked: the picker's filters and typed query, the
exercise just done whose usual followers lead, and the phone's wall clock in
seconds, as the phone's exercise picker asks.

FfiLinkPlannedEvents.description:
What `insights.plannedEvents` answers: the calendar events in the window,
oldest first.

FfiLinkPlannedEventsAsk.description:
What `insights.plannedEvents` is asked: an inclusive window of wall-clock
seconds, as the phone's calendar read takes it.

FfiLinkPowerCurve.description:
What `fitness.powerCurve` answers: the stored curve, or none when it was
never fetched.

FfiLinkPowerCurveAsk.description:
What `fitness.powerCurve` is asked: a sport and a window in days, where 0
is all time.

FfiLinkRecordingAnswer.description:
What `recordings.get` answers: the row, or `None` when it is absent or held by
another athlete, as the phone's own read answers `null`.

FfiLinkRecordingAsk.description: What `recordings.get` is asked: the recording's id.

FfiLinkRecordingsAnswer.description: What `recordings.list` answers: the rows the signed-in athlete may see, newest first.

FfiLinkRecordingsAsk.description:
What `recordings.list` is asked: nothing, the library is the signed-in
athlete's.

FfiLinkRestoreWorkoutAsk.description:
What `strength.restoreWorkout` is asked: a deleted workout as it was read
before the delete, to be put back under its id with its times.

FfiLinkRouteAttemptsAsk.description:
What `route.detail` and `route.attempts` are asked about, and what
`route.attempts` narrows by: the route, the activity being viewed and a sport.

FfiLinkRouteRenameAsk.description:
What `route.rename` is asked: the route and its new name, where an empty
name clears it.

FfiLinkSaveWorkoutAsk.description:
What `strength.saveWorkout` is asked: the workout the builder holds. With an
`id` it replaces that saved workout.

FfiLinkSectionAsk.description: What a method that edits one section is asked.

FfiLinkSectionAttempt.description:
One attempt on a section: the activity, when it was ridden, its time and
which way it ran.

FfiLinkSectionBest.description:
A best time with the activity and date that set it. `is_record` is the
section's record: the best over the whole included history.

FfiLinkSectionBests.description: The quickest attempt in each direction over the range.

FfiLinkSectionBoundsAsk.description:
What `section.editBounds` is asked: the section, the edit and the
parameters that edit reads. `trim` reads both indices, `expand` reads the
activity and both indices, `setReference` the activity and `revert` the
version. Any other parameter is ignored, and one the edit needs and the
ask lacks is refused.

FfiLinkSectionCreateAsk.description:
What `section.create` is asked: the stored activity whose track is cut,
the inclusive index range and the sport, with an optional name.

FfiLinkSectionCreated.description: What `section.create` answers: the section it made.

trendStartSecs.description: The trend curve's time at the window's first attempt.

trendEndSecs.description: The trend curve's time at the window's last attempt.

FfiLinkSectionDirectionTrend.description:
How one direction's counted attempts in the window have moved: how many,
their mean time, and the trend curve's first and last times.

FfiLinkSectionEdited.description:
What a section edit that can take rides out of the section answers: it was
made, and the rides it left out. The rides stay in the library.

FfiLinkSectionExcluded.description:
What `section.excluded` answers: the activities whose every traversal of
the section is excluded.

FfiLinkSectionExtension.description:
What `section.extensionTrack` answers: the activity the section is cut from, that
activity's whole stored track, and the inclusive indices where the section's line runs on it.

FfiLinkSectionHistory.description:
What `section.history` answers: the change ledger, oldest first, the
stored geometry versions with the pinned one flagged, and the names of the
activities the ledger's chips draw, so the page asks once.

FfiLinkSectionIdsAsk.description:
What `section.unaccept` and `section.acceptMany` are asked: the sections to
hand back to detection, or to accept.

FfiLinkSectionIdsEnabledAsk.description:
What `section.setEnabledMany` is asked: the sections and whether they are
all shown or all hidden. The write is one change: every id takes the choice
or none does.

FfiLinkSectionLiftAsk.description: What `section.setLift` is asked: the section and whether it is a lift.

FfiLinkSectionRenameAsk.description:
What `section.rename` is asked: the section and its new name, where an
empty name clears it.

sportType.description: The sport the answer is for.

traversalCount.description: Counted traversals over the whole record, whatever the window.

recent.description: Attempts inside the window, newest first, at most one page.

FfiLinkSectionStanding.description:
What `section.standing` answers: where one section stands, in a few
kilobytes.

FfiLinkSectionStandingAsk.description:
What `section.standing` is asked: the section, how many days back the
trend and the attempts reach, the sport, and how many recent attempts to
return (at most one page).

FfiLinkSectionTrend.description: The trend of each direction over the window.

FfiLinkSectionsAccepted.description:
What `section.acceptAll` and `section.acceptMany` answer: the sections the
call accepted, which are the ones `section.unaccept` takes back.

FfiLinkSettingSetAsk.description:
What `settings.set` is asked: a setting from [`WRITABLE_SETTINGS`] and one
of the values it offers.

FfiLinkSettingValue.description: One setting as stored; `value` is none when no row is stored.

FfiLinkSettingsAnswer.description:
What `settings.get` answers: the allowed keys with their values, and the
keys refused, which were not read.

FfiLinkSettingsAsk.description: What `settings.get` is asked: the keys to read.

FfiLinkSparklinesAsk.description: What `feed.sparklines` is asked: how many days the series reach back.

FfiLinkStreamsAsk.description:
What `activity.streams` is asked: the activity and the series the chart
draws, in any order.

FfiLinkStrengthAsk.description:
What `strength.screen` is asked: the phone's wall clock in seconds and the span
of days the period reads, as the strength tab picks it.

lastDone.description: The day of the latest session of the group, in wall-clock seconds.

FfiLinkStrengthGroup.description:
Sessions that did the same exercises, with the sets a new session of them
starts from.

FfiLinkStrengthGroups.description: What `strength.groups` answers: the recent groups, newest first.

FfiLinkStrictness.description:
The two numbers route grouping is matched by, as the phone's grouping
preview sets them: how much of a route has to match, in percent, and how
far apart the two ends may be, in metres.

FfiLinkSummaryAsk.description:
What `feed.summary` is asked: the phone's wall-clock time in seconds, from
which the engine resolves this week and the one before.

FfiLinkThresholdAsk.description:
What `settings.setThreshold` is asked: the sport the figure belongs to,
the figure, and its value, or `null` to clear the athlete's own figure so
the activity files answer again. `value` has to be present.

FfiLinkWellnessAsk.description: What `fitness.wellness` is asked: an inclusive window of `YYYY-MM-DD` days.

FfiLinkWorkoutAnswer.description: What `strength.workout` answers: `None` when no saved workout has the id.

FfiLinkWorkoutAsk.description: What `strength.workout` and the workout writes that name one are asked.

FfiLinkWorkoutRenameAsk.description: What `strength.renameWorkout` is asked: the workout and its new name.

FfiLinkWorkoutRow.description: A saved workout as the list shows it.

FfiLinkWorkoutSections.description: What `insights.workoutSections` answers: the ranked sections for the sport.

FfiLinkWorkoutSectionsAsk.description:
What `insights.workoutSections` is asked: the sport and how many sections
the list holds at most.

FfiLinkWorkouts.description: What `strength.workouts` answers: the saved workouts, last started first.

FfiLinkWriteDone.description: What a write answers once it is made.

FfiLinkZonesAsk.description:
What `fitness.zones` is asked: a sport, a zone kind (`power` or `hr`) and an
inclusive window of wall-clock seconds.

name.description: What the browser called itself when it was linked.

createdAt.description: Unix seconds when it was linked.

lastSeenAt.description: Unix seconds of its last connection, none before the first.

connectedSince.description:
Unix seconds when its current connection came up, none while it is not
connected.

FfiLinkedDevice.description: A browser linked to this phone.

FfiLiveEdit.description:
One change to the live session: its kind and the fields that kind reads.

`exercise` and `set` index the exercise and its set. `to` is the place a
moved exercise goes to or the exercise a grouped one joins. `group_no`
names a group for its rest. `category` and `name` pick the exercise to add.
`value` is the new reps, weight or duration, the rest in seconds, or the
direction of a stepper tap (1 up, -1 down); empty clears a value that may
be empty. `text` is a side and `flag` a warm-up.

FfiLiveEditKind.description: What a change to the live session is.

labelKey.description: The catalogue's key for the exercise; empty for a pair the catalogue does not name.

groupNo.description: The group the exercise is done with, by number.

restSecs.description: The rest planned after the exercise on its own, in seconds.

FfiLiveStrengthExercise.description: One exercise of the live strength session, named and classed by the catalogue.

FfiLiveStrengthGroup.description: The rest planned after a group of exercises.

prefilledDaysAgo.description: For an exercise added with sets from an earlier session, the whole days since it.

FfiLiveStrengthOutcome.description: The live session after an edit.

weightUnit.description: The unit the athlete reads and enters weight in.

begun.description: The session has begun; before that it is being prepared.

currentExercise.description: The set the session is at, by exercise and set index.

restStartedAt.description: When the rest in progress began, if one is.

notes.description:
The lines of the plan this session was started from that are not
exercises, as the plan wrote them.

FfiLiveStrengthSession.description: The strength session being recorded: the one read the recorder draws.

displayWeight.description: The weight as the athlete reads it, in the session's `weight_unit`, to one decimal.

side.description: Which side of a one-sided exercise, when the athlete said.

FfiLiveStrengthSet.description: One set of an exercise in the live strength session.

family.description:
The sport's family, lower case as `FfiFamilyHours` names it: `ride`,
`winter`, `run`, `water`, `foot`, `strength` or `other`.

load.description: The recorded training load, zero when none is recorded.

FfiLoadDot.description: One activity as the fitness strip marks it and its day picker lists it.

FfiLoadMetric.description:
Which total a period comparison was taken on. A week with no training load
recorded still has moving time, so the comparison falls back rather than
reading zero against zero.
