originDay.description: The day the line is anchored on, `YYYY-MM-DD`: the first point's day.

slopePerDay.description: The change in load per day.

spread.description: The standard deviation of the points about the line, zero for two.

FfiLoadTrend.description:
A least-squares line of load against day, with the spread of the points
about it.

FfiMapEmptyReason.description:
Why the map draws no activity, so the tab names its cause rather than
showing a bare basemap.

activityCount.description: Total activities held by the engine, before the date and sport filters

availableSportTypes.description: Sport types with at least one activity

categoryCounts.description: Mapped activities by display group in the date window before filters

activities.description: Activities inside the requested window and sport filter

routeCount.description:
Routes the map can draw: groups of at least two activities with a
stored line. Zero while the route-line layer is stale.

routeLines.description:
The pre-built route lines, present only when the read asked for them
and the layer is current

sectionCount.description: Visible sections, regardless of whether the overlay was requested

sections.description: The section overlay, present only while the layer is requested

emptyReason.description:
Why the map draws no activity, from the date window's own counts.
`None` while `activities` holds one.

unmapped.description:
The window's activities with no stored track that pass the same sport,
distance and name filters as `activities`, so the two together are
every activity in the period the filters keep.

FfiMapScreenData.description: Everything the map tab paints with in one call.

name.description: The live name when the section has one, so the caller needs no overlay read.

sportTypes.description: Every sport whose included outings have taken the section, sorted.

klass.description:
climb, descent, rolling, flat or loop; None when nothing says. With the
grade below, this is what the auto-generated label is built from, so the
map's names do not change when it stops taking the whole record.

maxGradePercent.description: Steepest grade (%) held over 300 m of the slice.

encodedPolyline.description: Delta+varint encoded coordinates, as every other track leaves the engine.

FfiMapSection.description:
A section as the regional map draws it: a line, a colour key and a label.

The map used to take the whole `FfiSection` for this, which clones
`activity_ids`, one `activity_portions` record per traversal and the point
density per section, then converted every portion in JavaScript and threw all
of it away. These are the six fields the map actually reads.

stamp.description:
The database state the overlay was read in, passed back to say the
caller still holds it. `None` when the read could not vouch for one.

sections.description: The sections, absent when the caller passed back this layer's `stamp`.

FfiMapSectionLayer.description:
The section overlay the map draws, stamped so a filter change that re-reads
the map does not ship a catalogue the caller already holds.

FfiMapSignature.description:
Lightweight map signature for rendering activity traces on the map.
Contains simplified GPS points (max ~100 via Douglas-Peucker) as encoded coords.

withoutGps.description:
No track is owed: no GPS upstream, a track refused for good, or one the
download gave up on, as `FfiMapEmptyReason::NoGps` reads it.

downloading.description: A track is upstream and the GPS download has still to fetch it.

FfiMapUnmapped.description: The activities a map read keeps but cannot draw, by why.

FfiMaxHrSource.description: Where an activity's max HR came from.

sportTypes.description: Every sport whose included outings have taken the section, sorted.

encodedPolyline.description:
The candidate's line thinned to what a row thumbnail draws, delta+varint
encoded as `FfiRecentPr.encoded_polyline` is. Empty when it cannot be read.

FfiMergeCandidate.description: Candidate for merging with another section.

FfiMergeDropped.description:
A ride a merge would take out of the section it is merged into. The ride
stays in the library.

FfiMergeOutcome.description: A merge's result: the section kept and the rides that left it.

year.description: Calendar year, in the athlete's own timezone.

stats.description: The same four totals `get_period_stats` gives a window.

FfiMonthlyStats.description: One calendar month's totals, for the season chart's month bars.

exercises.description: Sorted by activity count descending, then by sets.

FfiMuscleExercises.description: One muscle's exercises over the period, for the list under the diagram.

FfiMuscleGroup.description: A muscle group activation, matching react-native-body-highlighter slug format.

FfiMuscleGroupDetail.description:
Full muscle-group breakdown for one activity, one muscle slug. Rust groups
exercise sets by display name, classifies primary/secondary, and returns
totals - replacing the useMemo grouping/reducing in `useMuscleDetail`.

primarySets.description: Number of sets where this muscle is primary target

secondarySets.description: Number of sets where this muscle is secondary target

totalReps.description: Reps targeting this muscle, with secondary work counted at half

volumeKg.description: Weight × reps in kg, with secondary work counted at half

exerciseNames.description: Human-readable exercise names that targeted this muscle

shade.description:
Body-diagram shade, 1 (lightest) to `DIAGRAM_SHADES`, against the
most trained muscle in the same summary

FfiMuscleVolume.description: Aggregated muscle group volume over a time period.

FfiNearbyKind.description: Whether a nearby place is a route or a section.

distanceMeters.description: The place's own length in metres.

awayMeters.description: Metres from the point to where the place starts.

offered.description:
Whether the place starts within [`NEARBY_RADIUS_METRES`] of the point. A followed route
beyond it is returned so it can be described, but is not offered.

bestDate.description: Unix seconds of the best attempt.

lastDate.description: Unix seconds of the latest counted attempt.

encodedCoords.description: The line simplified to at most [`NEARBY_LINE_POINTS`] points, with elevation where stored.

packedLine.description:
The same line as [`pack_line`](crate::persistence::codec::pack_line) writes it, in place of
`encoded_coords`, which is then empty. Present only when the read was asked to pack.

FfiNearbyPlace.description: One route or section near a point, with what a list of them shows.

FfiOffScale.description: Where a scatter point lies against its direction's focus range.

times.description: Seconds taken to cover each distance.

pace.description: Metres per second at each distance, zero where the time is.

criticalSpeed.description: The critical-speed model's terms, when the server fitted one.

fetchedAt.description: Epoch seconds at the fetch that stored the body.

source.description:
`intervals` for a body the server sent, `veloq` for one worked out on
the phone from the library's own streams, which the chart says.

FfiPaceCurve.description: A pace curve for one sport and window, and when its body was fetched.

latestPace.description: Most recent critical speed in m/s

latestDate.description: Date of most recent snapshot (Unix timestamp seconds)

previousPace.description: Previous different critical speed in m/s

previousDate.description: Date of previous snapshot (Unix timestamp seconds)

gainPercent.description:
The move from `previous_pace` to `latest_pace` as a percent of the
earlier speed, positive for faster. `None` with nothing to compare
against.

deltaSeconds.description:
The same move in seconds per unit distance, the unit the sport is
paced in: 100 m for swimming, a kilometre otherwise. Positive is
seconds saved.

glyph.description:
The arrow the move draws, judged on pace in the unit the sport is paced
in by [`crate::trend_table::glyph`]: up for faster. Flat when no earlier
snapshot differs, `None` with no snapshot at all.

sampleCount.description:
Snapshots the trend was read from, for the same reason as
`FfiFtpTrend::sample_count`.

history.description:
Those snapshots, oldest first, for the same reason as
`FfiFtpTrend::history`.

FfiPaceTrend.description: Pace trend data (critical speed for running/swimming).

metric.description: The total both values are under.

current.description: The later period's total, in TSS or in seconds.

previous.description: The earlier period's total, on the same metric.

ratio.description: `current / previous - 1`, so 0.28 is 28% more than the period before.

comparedStart.description:
Epoch seconds where the later period starts, the week the verdict is
about, so a graphic of the weekly totals can mark it.

FfiPeriodComparison.description:
One period measured against another, on whichever total both carry.

The card's threshold test is the reader's: this says how far apart the two
periods are and on what, not whether that is worth saying.

FfiPeriodStats.description: Aggregated stats for a date range.

FfiPickerMuscle.description: A muscle the body pair can select and the region it belongs to.

distanceMetres.description: A prescribed distance. Any duration beside it is an estimate, not a countdown.

FfiPlanLine.description: One line of the flat list the athlete follows.

FfiPlanLineKind.description: Whether a plan line is effort or recovery.

FfiPlanTarget.description: The measure a planned workout is prescribed in.

FfiPlannedCategory.description: What kind of entry a calendar event is.

day.description: The local day the event is planned for, `YYYY-MM-DD`.

sport.description: The activity type the event is planned as, `Ride`, `Run` and so on.

movingTime.description: The planned moving time, in seconds.

lines.description:
The workout's steps as the lines the athlete follows. Empty for an
event that is not a workout, or a workout with nothing to follow.

bar.description: The step bar, one block per line.

FfiPlannedEvent.description: A calendar event as the screens read it.

index.description: The length's place in the file, from zero, rests counted.

active.description: False for a rest, which the device records as an idle length.

stroke.description: The FIT SwimStroke number. None for a rest or an unrecorded stroke.

strokeKey.description:
A locale key naming the stroke (`freestyle`, `breaststroke`, ...),
`unknown` for an active length with no stroke. None for a rest.

elapsedSecs.description: Seconds from the push-off to the wall, or the rest's duration.

speedMps.description: Metres per second over the pool length. None for a rest.

swolf.description:
Elapsed seconds plus strokes. None for a rest or a length with no
stroke count or no time.

FfiPoolLength.description: One length of the pool, or one rest.

distanceM.description: Lengths times the pool length. None when the pool length is unknown.

speedMps.description: Distance over time. None when either is unknown or zero.

avgSwolf.description: The mean SWOLF of the lengths that have one.

FfiPoolStrokeTotal.description: One stroke's share of a pool swim, over its active lengths.

poolLengthM.description: The pool length in metres, whichever unit the device showed.

poolUnit.description: The unit the pool is measured in. Metres when the length is unknown.

lengths.description: Every length in file order, rests in place. Empty unless `Read`.

strokeTotals.description:
One per stroke swum, in the order each stroke first appears, over the
active lengths alone.

FfiPoolSwim.description: A pool swim's lengths as the activity detail screen paints them.

FfiPoolSwimState.description:
Where a pool swim's lengths stand, read from its FIT file. The
discriminants start at one so no member is falsy.

FfiPoolUnit.description:
The unit a pool is measured in, inferred from its length. The
discriminants start at one so no member is falsy.

watts.description: The best watts held for each duration.

wkgActivityIds.description: Activity ids for each per-kilogram best, which need not be the watts one.

weight.description: The athlete's weight the per-kilogram series was divided by.

models.description: The server's fitted models, in the order it sent them.

activities.description: Every activity a point came from, so a checkpoint has a date offline.

fetchedAt.description: Epoch seconds at the fetch that stored the body.

source.description:
`intervals` for a body the server sent, `veloq` for one worked out on
the phone from the library's own streams, which the chart says.

FfiPowerCurve.description: A power curve for one sport and window, and when its body was fetched.

wPrime.description: W prime, joules above critical power.

pMax.description: The three-parameter models' peak, absent on the two-parameter fit.

FfiPowerModel.description: A model the server finished fitting.

minWatts.description: Lower edge in watts, 0 for zone 1

maxWatts.description: Upper edge in watts, absent for the open top zone

percent.description: Share of the total time in zones, 0 to 100

share.description: The share as a whole percent, the bands' shares totalling 100

FfiPowerZoneBand.description: One power zone of a saved activity.

FfiPreviewTrack.description: GPS track for a single activity (for feed map previews).

improvementChange.description:
Signed fraction the athlete got faster by before the score clamps it,
+0.14 for 14% faster and -1.5 for 150% slower. Absent with fewer than
three efforts or a nonpositive earlier time, never an invented zero.

improvementBasis.description: What `improvement_change` compares, absent when it is.

recentEfforts.description:
The last efforts on the section, oldest first, capped by the ranker's
own limit. The scoring already holds every traversal to compute the
medians above, so carrying the tail of them costs the ranker nothing.

bestActivityId.description:
The activity `best_time_secs` was set in. Absent when no stored
traversal matches the best, which a stale rank cache can cause.

FfiRankedSection.description:
A section ranked by composite relevance score combining recency, improvement,
anomaly detection, and engagement signals.

FfiRankedSectionsBySport.description:
Ranked sections for one sport, paired with the sport label. One element
per input sport in `get_ranked_sections_batch`.

sportType.description:
The sport the record was set in. Shared ground holds a record in each
sport that travels it and neither is measured against the other's laps,
so a row that names no sport leaves the card labelling a run with a
bicycle.

traversalCount.description:
Traversals in that sport, one per pass. A record set over three outings
and one set over fifty are different claims, and the ranker has no other
way to tell them apart. It counted the section's own traversals until
2026-09-20, so three runs on a much-ridden climb claimed the rides.

standingCount.description: Timed, eligible laps in the record's direction.

percentileFaster.description: Percent of other counted laps slower than the record, when at least three count.

previousBestTime.description: The next fastest counted lap in the record's direction.

recentEfforts.description:
The last efforts on the section, oldest first, capped by
`FfiInsightsParams::history_limit`. What the card draws, so the list
does not read the engine again per card to draw a line it already had.

encodedPolyline.description:
The section's own line, delta+varint encoded as every other track
leaves the engine, thinned to what a thumbnail can draw. A record on
"section 6" says nothing about which stretch of road that is, and the
summary this row is built from already holds the geometry.

bestActivityId.description:
The activity the record was set in, so the section opens at its best
effort. Absent when the record's activity cannot be named.

FfiRecentPr.description: A recent section PR detected in the last 7 days.

FfiRecordMove.description: A record's time before and after a re-cut, within one sport and direction.

FfiRecordProgressions.description:
The record progression per direction, oldest step first, over the whole
included history. Empty in a direction that holds no record.

improvementSecs.description: Seconds faster than the step before. `None` on the first step.

improvementSpeed.description:
Metres per second faster than the step before. `None` on the first
step.

FfiRecordStep.description:
One step of a direction's record progression: an eligible lap strictly
faster than every eligible lap before it.

kind.description:
`fit` for a ride this device recorded, `manual` for an entry the athlete
typed. A manual row has no FIT and an empty `fit_path`, so the upload path
branches on this rather than on whether a file happens to be there.

streamsPath.description:
A manual entry's request body. On a ride an earlier build saved, a
streams copy that is no longer written or read, kept only so a delete
takes the file with the row.

startTime.description: Milliseconds since the epoch, when the ride started.

createdAt.description: Milliseconds since the epoch, when the recording was saved.

engineActivityId.description: The engine key the recording was written under at save time.

engineReconciled.description:
Whether the engine row has taken the id intervals.icu gave the upload.
False on a ride uploaded while the engine was closed, which is the case
the reconcile sweep exists to replay.

athleteId.description:
The athlete signed in when the recording was saved. `None` on a row
written before the column existed, which is not the same as a row that
belongs to nobody: an unstamped entry is held rather than uploaded.

notes.description:
What the athlete wrote on the review screen. It goes up as the
activity's description.

rpe.description:
The effort from 1 to 10 the athlete set on the review screen, `None`
when the slider was never moved.

rpeSent.description:
Whether intervals.icu has the effort. It goes up after the upload, so a
failed update is retried from here without sending the file again.

FfiRecordingEntry.description: One recording, as the library screen and the upload processor see it.

FfiReferenceSource.description:
Which lap a direction's deltas are measured against. The stored curves are
measured against `Record` or `AthleteSet`; the others are references a
chart re-bases onto.

pairsPending.description:
The engine is still working out which lines share ground, so a line
whose ground pairs are owed lists only its ledger and supersedes links.

FfiRetiredMapData.description: Everything the old-versus-new sections map draws, in one read.

overlap.description: The larger of the two coverage fractions, for a `Ground` pair only.

FfiRetiredMapPair.description: One retired section set against one catalogue row.

encodedPolyline.description: Delta+varint encoded coordinates; `None` when no stored version decodes.

FfiRetiredMapSection.description:
A retired section as the old-versus-new map draws it: the ledger's record
of it and its newest stored line that decodes.

FfiRetiredPairLink.description: Why a retired section and a catalogue row are shown together.

kind.description:
dissolved, merged or superseded. A state a record restore still holds
pending reads superseded, with no survivor.

into.description: The survivor a merge or supersession handed the ground to.

name.description:
The name it was last shown under, so two retirements can be told
apart. `None` when nothing the ledger kept names it.

distanceMeters.description: Its length when it left, else its newest stored line's.

visitCount.description:
How many passes it had when it left: its retirement event's count,
else the newest archived state's. `None` when neither recorded one.

restorableVersion.description:
The version a restore rolls it back to: the newest `archived` state
that names a sport, which is what recreating the row needs. `None`
when no such state exists, and for a state a record restore still
holds pending, whose ground is not present yet.

FfiRetiredSection.description:
A section the ledger remembers and the catalogue no longer holds: its
last event says how it left, and its stored versions still draw it.

activityCount.description: Total activities held by the engine

group.description:
The route itself, or `None` when the ID is unknown. Its `custom_name`
is the name it is shown under.

distanceMeters.description:
The representative activity's distance in meters, the figure the routes
list shows and sorts on. Zero when the route is unknown.

elevationGainMeters.description:
The representative activity's elevation gain in meters, the climbing
the route hero shows beside its distance. Zero when the route is
unknown.

excludedActivityIds.description: Activities the user excluded from this route

mapSignatures.description: Simplified GPS signatures for the route's activities

missingTimeStreamIds.description:
The route's activities whose time streams still have to be fetched
before the delta curves can draw them

FfiRouteDetailData.description:
Everything the route detail screen paints with that one sport and one
range do not change. It carries this route and nothing of any other, so it
stays the same size as the library grows; the attempt times come from the
route detail performance read.

isRecentRecord.description:
The bucket's fastest counted attempt beats every other and fell inside
the recent record window.

trend.description:
-1 slower, 0 stable or too few attempts, 1 faster, on the median
window rule sections use.

trendSeconds.description:
The trend's size: the recent median moving time minus the previous
median, in seconds, negative faster. `None` where `trend` is 0.

bestTime.description: The fastest counted attempt's moving time, in seconds.

daysSinceLast.description:
Whole days from the newest counted attempt to the end of the current
week.

attemptCount.description:
Counted attempts: timed, not excluded, not partial, inside the
distance band.

recentEfforts.description:
The last counted attempts' moving times, oldest first, capped by
`FfiInsightsParams::history_limit`.

FfiRouteInsight.description:
One route's standing in one sport and one direction, for the insights
panel. A route ridden and run is two rows, and forward and reverse are two
more, because none of those attempts is measured against another's.

routeNumber.description: The number the route is shown under, absent until one is minted

name.description:
The name the route is shown under, read when the map is, so a rename
shows without the layer being rebuilt

distanceMeters.description:
The representative's distance in metres, the figure the route list
shows, read when the map is

generation.description:
The route group generation the lines were built from. Declared as a
double, which holds every generation a library reaches exactly.

stamp.description:
The database state the layer was read in, which the caller passes back
to say it still holds these lines. `None` when the read could not vouch
for one.

routes.description:
The lines, absent when the caller passed back this layer's `stamp`:
nothing has committed since, so the lines and names it holds are these.

FfiRouteLineLayer.description:
The route-line layer the map draws, with the generation it was built from
so the front end can keep what it decoded while the generation is unchanged.

isCurrent.description: Is this the current activity being viewed

matchPercentage.description: Match percentage (0-100), None if no match data available

outsideDistanceBand.description:
True when the recorded distance sits outside the band around the
route's usual distance, so the attempt holds no record and is not
counted in the rank.

isRecord.description:
True when this attempt strictly beats every other counted attempt in
its sport and direction, under the one record rule.

FfiRoutePerformance.description: A single performance point for route comparison.

activityMetrics.description: Activity metrics for all activities in the route (inlined to avoid duplicate FFI call)

best.description: Fastest forward performance, or fastest reverse when none ran forward.

currentDirectionBest.description: Best performance in the current activity's direction.

currentRank.description: Current activity's standing, with rank one reserved for a strict record.

attemptCount.description: Timed comparable attempts in the current direction.

percentileRank.description:
Share of those attempts slower than the current one, 0 to 100.
`None` for a lone attempt or an activity that is not on the route.

trendCurves.description:
The trend curve and band over the counted attempts, for the scatter
chart: the same smoother a section's chart uses.

histograms.description: The histogram of those attempts' elapsed times, per direction.

FfiRoutePerformanceResult.description:
Route performance result for FFI.
Complete performance data for a route group across all activities.
Replaces the JSON-returning `persistent_engine_get_route_performances_json()`.

groupCount.description:
How many routes the minimum activity count leaves, before the search and
the sport narrow them. A group ridden once is not a route, so it is not
counted here.

hasMoreGroups.description: Whether more groups are available beyond the current page

hasMoreSections.description: Whether more sections are available beyond the current page

groupsDirty.description: Whether route groups need recomputation (stale after activity removal)

groupsHold.description:
What keeps the owed regroup from running. An upgrade leaves it to the
detector cutover, which waits behind the elevation download, so this is
the hold ranked as the sections page ranks it while the cutover holds
the regroup. `None` when no regroup is owed, when one is in flight, or
when nothing holds it, and `groups_dirty` then means it is running or
about to.

filteredGroupCount.description:
How many groups the minimum activity count, the sport and the search
leave. This is what the page is taken out of, and what `has_more_groups`
is measured against. `group_count` is the scope it is taken out of.

filteredSectionCount.description: How many sections the search and the hidden filters leave.

unacceptedAutoCount.description:
Auto sections the athlete has not accepted, over the whole catalogue and
not the page, because this is the "N to review" figure.

acceptedAutoCount.description: Auto sections the athlete has accepted, over the whole catalogue.

customCount.description:
Custom sections over the whole catalogue. The chip beside it filters the
catalogue, so a page-sized tally would be a lower bound nothing labels.

removedCount.description:
Auto sections the athlete disabled or a custom one superseded, over the
whole catalogue. Taken before `hide_disabled` runs, which is the filter
this figure is the count for and which hides them by default. Distinct
from `ledger_retired_count`: a disabled row is still in the catalogue,
a ledger retirement has left it.

ledgerRetiredCount.description:
Sections that left the catalogue through a fired retirement and still
hold a ledger, the graveyard the retired screen lists, a record
restore's pending states included. This is what the entry points to the
graveyard gate on, and it is not the `removed_count` of disabled rows.

archivedRetiredCount.description:
Of those, the ones that hold an `archived` row: the cutover's, or a
record restore's pending state. A later detect that dissolves a section
leaves no archived row, so a library with no cutover reads zero here,
which is what the "your matching changed" card gates on.

availableSportTypes.description: The sports the athlete has activities in, which the sport chips offer.

groupEmptyReason.description:
Why the routes catalogue holds no route with the minimum activity
count, whatever the search and the sport filter. `None` while it holds
one, so an empty page under a search is a search that matched nothing.

sectionEmptyReason.description:
Why the sections catalogue holds no section of any kind, hidden or not.
`None` while it holds one.

FfiRoutesScreenData.description:
All data needed by the Routes screen in a single FFI call.
Supports pagination via limit/offset for groups and sections.

groupSearch.description: Case-insensitive substring of the group name. Empty matches everything.

sectionSearch.description: Case-insensitive substring of the section name. Empty matches everything.

groupSportType.description:
Keeps the groups whose members include this sport. A group is in every
sport any member was recorded in, so a mixed route shows under each.

sectionSportType.description:
Keeps the sections taken in this sport, and makes `Signature` read the
within-sport percentile rather than the pooled one.

FfiRoutesScreenQuery.description:
Everything the Routes screen asks for in one call. The order, the search and
the filters are arguments because they have to be applied before the page is
taken: a sort over the page returns the longest route of the first fifty,
not of the library.

FfiScatterFocus.description: The focus range per direction. `None` for a direction with no point.

sportTypes.description:
Every sport whose included outings have taken the section, sorted. A
section has no sport of its own, so this set is the whole answer.

activityPortions.description:
Each activity's portion of the section. Only the in-memory catalogue
carries these, so the database path sends an empty list.

routeIds.description: Routes the section's activities are grouped into, from the junction join

FfiSection.description:
Unified section for FFI. Represents both auto-detected and custom sections
with the same structure.

startTime.description: Unix seconds, as stored by the engine.

averageSpeed.description: Metres per second; zero when moving time is zero.

FfiSectionActivityRow.description: An activity row in the section detail read.

sectionName.description:
The name the athlete is shown for the section: their own, else its
number, else the composition from its split parent. The id when the
section has none.

encodedPolyline.description:
The section's line as it now stands, delta+varint encoded and thinned
as `FfiRecentPr.encoded_polyline` is. Empty when it cannot be read.

FfiSectionChange.description: A recent change on a live section, for the insights feed.

lengthBefore.description: The line's length in metres in the version before, when one is stored.

lengthAfter.description: The line's length in metres in the row's version.

moved.description:
The part of the line that moved: `start`, `end`, `both`, or `split`
for a split. Absent when neither end moved.

atMetres.description: For a split, the distance along the line in metres where it was cut.

reason.description:
The boundary record nearest the part that moved. Absent when the row
stored none there, or only a kind this build does not explain.

records.description:
The records that moved with this re-cut, folded from the rows written
beside it.

foldedInto.description: On a record row folded onto a re-cut, the id of that re-cut's row.

FfiSectionChangeSummary.description:
The headline of a ledger row and at most one reason, computed in the
engine so no screen does geometry or arithmetic on counts.

bestTimeSecs.description: The quickest lap in the section's own direction.

bestTimeEstimated.description:
`best_time_secs` is an estimate: no lap in the direction it was read
from was timed on the ground.

firstActivityDate.description: The oldest point's date, unix seconds.

FfiSectionChartData.description:
Bundled chart payload for the section-detail screen. Rust composes
per-lap points, ranks, and summary stats from the performance records
it already owns so the TS hook stops iterating + sorting multiple times.

isBest.description:
The section record for this point's direction: the one traversal that
beats every other by time over the whole included history, whatever
range the chart shows. False for a tie, a lone traversal, and any point
when the range holds no record traversal.

avgPower.description:
The lap's stored mean watts. `None` for a lap with no power stream and
for a record without laps, which has no single lap to read it from.

outsideDistanceBand.description:
A route attempt outside the band around the route's usual distance:
drawn, but never the record, fitted or binned. Always false on a
section.

matchPercentage.description:
How much of the route the attempt matched, 0 to 100. `None` on a
section, and on a route attempt with no stored match.

offScale.description:
Which side of its direction's focus range the point lies past, so the
scatter draws it at the edge with a flag rather than stretching the
axis.

recordGapSecs.description:
Seconds behind the direction's record: zero for the record holder,
positive for a slower attempt. `None` for an excluded attempt, one
outside a route's distance band, and in a direction with no record.

recordGapSpeed.description:
Metres per second behind the direction's record, signed as
`record_gap_secs` is: positive is slower. `None` where it is.

estimated.description:
The lap's time was projected to a gate over ground the recording did
not cover. Charted and ranked, and the record only when no lap in its
direction was timed on the ground.

FfiSectionChartPoint.description:
One renderable chart point on the section-detail chart. One entry per
lap traversal (activities with multiple laps expand into multiple points).

familySize.description:
Variables of this direction that carried an estimate: the family the
mover label was Holm-adjusted across. The same on every row of a
direction, and 0 when none of them had enough pairs.

FfiSectionCorrelation.description: One wellness variable's relationship to attempt speed in one direction.

activityCount.description: Total activities held by the engine

section.description: The section itself, or `None` when the ID is unknown

retirement.description:
How the section left the catalogue, when the ID has no row and the
ledger holds its departure

mergeCandidates.description: Sections this one could merge with

excludedActivityIds.description: Activities the user excluded from this section

hasOriginalBounds.description: Whether the original bounds can still be restored

activityRows.description: Display rows for every activity on the section

mapSignatures.description: Simplified GPS signatures for scrub-time trace display

missingTimeStreamIds.description: Activities whose time streams still have to be fetched

history.description: The section's change ledger, oldest first

geometryVersions.description: Every stored geometry version, with the pinned one flagged

pinnedVersion.description: The pinned version, or `None` when the section follows the newest cut

FfiSectionDetailData.description: The section detail reads that do not depend on time streams.

startIndex.description:
Where this activity's track first enters the section in this direction.
Encounters come back ordered by it.

lapTime.description: This activity's time on this section in this direction

lapPace.description: This activity's pace on this section in this direction

isPr.description: Whether this activity holds the PR for this (section, direction)

isComplete.description: Whether this traversal meets the section's completion rule.

rank.description:
Podium place, 1 to 3, among the other outings on this (section,
direction); `None` for fourth and below, a fragment or a lone outing.
`is_pr` is exactly `rank == Some(1)`.

visitCount.description: How many total traversals exist for this (section, direction)

historyTimes.description: Historical lap times for sparkline (chronological, all activities in this direction)

historyActivityIds.description: Activity IDs corresponding to history_times (for highlighting current activity)

historyDates.description:
Start of each activity in history_times, Unix seconds, so the sparkline
can place each outing at its date

FfiSectionEncounter.description:
A section encounter: one (section, direction) pair for a given activity.
This is the canonical unit for displaying section data in the activity detail.

direction.description:
`same` or `reverse`; absent on a row written before records were held
per direction.

FfiSectionEraRecord.description: One sport's record in one direction on a section when an era ended.

around.description: Activities that arrived while the change was pending.

forkAround.description: Activities a fork at the line's end collected.

prs.description:
The era's records, one per sport and direction; a row written before
records were held per direction carries no direction, and one written
before they were held per sport carries one record and no sport.

prFrom.description:
A re-based record's time before and after, within `pr_sport` and
`pr_direction`.

prDirection.description:
`same` or `reverse`; absent on a row written before records were held
per direction.

siblings.description: The sections a split left behind, in line order.

reanchoredFrom.description: The activity a re-anchor moved the line off, and the one it moved to.

moved.description: Whether an anchoring moved the line; absent on a row that does not say.

splitFrom.description: The section a split piece was carved from, with its standing now.

splitInto.description: The pieces a split left, with their standing now.

boundaries.description:
Why the detector cut the line where it did, one entry per record that
names this section, in the detector's order. Empty when the change
recorded none.

summary.description:
What the change did to the line and the one reason for it, read from
the row's version and the one before. Absent on a row that is not a
detector change.

FfiSectionEventDetails.description:
The fixed fields of a ledger row's stored payload. Keys a row does not
carry read as empty lists and absent options, and keys this record does
not name are ignored, so a row written by an older or newer build reads.

FfiSectionFilters.description:
The four kinds the sections list can hide. Each is true when that kind is
hidden, which is how the screen holds them.

FfiSectionGeometryVersion.description: One stored geometry version of a section.

kind.description:
formed, restored, split, recut, dissolved, merged, superseded,
reverted, pr_rebased, baseline, algorithm_changed, name_released or
name_taken.

details.description:
What the row recorded, read from the stored payload. Absent when the
row stored none or stored something unreadable.

FfiSectionHistoryEvent.description: One ledger row of a section.

startIndex.description: Start index in the activity's GPS track

endIndex.description: End index in the activity's GPS track

avgHr.description: Mean heart rate over the lap, when the activity carried a stream.

avgPower.description: Mean watts over the lap, when the activity carried a power stream.

coverage.description: Share of the section this lap spans, `None` until it is measured.

excluded.description:
The athlete excluded this traversal. Only a read that asked for
excluded rows carries one, and it never counts.

outsideDistanceBand.description:
A route attempt whose distance sits outside the band around the
route's usual distance: drawn, never counted. Always false for a
section lap.

matchPercentage.description:
How much of the route a route attempt matched, 0 to 100. `None` for a
section lap.

isRecord.description:
This lap holds the section's record in its direction. Set by the
section read, false everywhere else.

estimated.description:
The lap's time was projected to a gate over ground the recording did
not cover, far enough that it is an estimate. It is charted and ranked,
and never the record while a lap timed on the ground stands.

FfiSectionLap.description: A single lap of a section.

gridStepM.description: Metres between two points of a lap's `delta_secs`.

splitStepM.description: Metres each of a lap's `split_delta_secs` spans; the last is short.

sectionLengthM.description: The section's line length the grid runs over.

FfiSectionLapCurves.description: The distance-domain deltas of one sport's laps on a section, per direction.

FfiSectionLink.description: A section the ledger names, with whether the catalogue still shows it.

sportType.description:
The sport this answer is for: the one asked for, or with none asked
on ground more than one sport has taken, the one with the most
outings. `None` when no traversal has a known sport.

sportCounts.description: Laps per sport over the range, the pills' counts, most outings first.

calendarSummary.description:
Year and month performance history over the whole record, or `None`
with no records

performances.description:
Per-activity performance records inside the range, with the bests and
direction stats taken over them

chartData.description: Pre-computed chart payload for the range

excludedPoints.description:
The excluded traversals inside the range, as chart points, for the
show-excluded view. Never counted, fitted or ranked.

lapRecords.description:
Every activity's laps over the whole record, included and excluded,
each flagged: the lap list, where an excluded lap keeps its undo.

bestForwardIsRecord.description:
True when the forward best shown is the forward record: the same lap
as the best over the whole included history, and a strict beat of that
history's second best. A ranged best that is not is only the best of
the range.

bestReverseIsRecord.description: The same for the reverse best.

trendCurves.description:
The trend curve and band over the counted attempts of the range, for
the scatter chart.

histograms.description: The histogram of those attempts' section times, per direction.

correlations.description:
Each recorded wellness variable's relationship to attempt speed over
the counted attempts, per direction.

correlationFloor.description:
Complete pairs a variable needed before its correlation carries a
figure: the floor every `TooFew` above fell short of.

curves.description:
Each lap's time won or lost against the section's reference at every
point along it, for the laps inside the range. `None` when neither
direction holds a lap to compare with its reference.

curvesPending.description:
True when this read left the curves owed rather than computing them:
a detail screen's read serves them only once held, and
`SectionManager::load_detail_performance` computes them off the JS
thread.

efficiencyTrend.description:
Aerobic efficiency over the answered sport's counted efforts across the
whole record, or `None` with fewer than three that carry heart rate.

scatterFocus.description:
The range each direction's scatter axis draws, with the points past it
counted. Speed on a section, time on a route.

recordProgression.description:
Each direction's record progression over the whole included history,
whatever the range: the screen draws the steps inside the range and
carries the level in from before it.

FfiSectionPerformanceData.description:
The section detail reads that need lap times, all for one sport and one
range, so no two figures on the screen disagree about which laps count.

laps.description: All laps for this activity on this section

lapCount.description: Number of times this section was traversed

bestEstimated.description:
`best_time` is an estimate: every eligible lap of the direction it was
taken from was projected to a gate.

FfiSectionPerformanceRecord.description: Section performance record for an activity.

records.description: Performance records sorted by date (oldest first)

bestForwardIsPr.description: Whether the forward best strictly beats another forward outing.

bestReverseIsPr.description: Whether the reverse best strictly beats another reverse outing.

FfiSectionPerformanceResult.description:
Section performance result for FFI.
Complete performance data for a section across all activities.
Replaces the JSON-returning `persistent_engine_get_section_performances_json()`.

into.description: The live section that took its ground, following the chain to its end

intoName.description: Display name of `into`, when it has one

FfiSectionRetirement.description: How a section left the catalogue, for the page that can no longer show it.

FfiSectionSort.description:
The order the sections list is in. `Signature` is the engine's
interestingness percentile, pooled or within one sport.

count.description: Laps the chart would plot under this sport, not activities.

FfiSectionSportCount.description: How many traversals of a section one sport made over the chosen range.

encodedCoords.description: Delta+varint encoded coordinates of the activity's portion

FfiSectionTrace.description: One activity's portion of a single section, delta+varint encoded.

forwardTime.description: Section time in seconds, forward attempts

reverseTime.description: Section time in seconds, reverse attempts

FfiSectionTrendCurves.description:
The Gaussian kernel trend of a section's counted attempts, per direction
and axis. `None` for a direction with fewer than two attempts. Excluded
attempts are never in it.

sportTypes.description: Every sport whose included outings have taken the section, sorted.

latestIsRecord.description:
The section's record was set on its most recent outing. The feed card
and the activity plot both mark a record; this is the same fact keyed by
section, so the sections list can mark it too.

trend.description: Faster or slower in the selected sport, or the sport with most visits.

FfiSectionWithPolyline.description:
Section summary with embedded polyline for the Routes screen.
Carries each section's line so the screen needs no per-section read.

activityId.description:
The activity the value was recorded in, for a series whose points are
efforts. Absent where a point is a day's estimate with no activity
behind it. A card marks and opens the activity a point stands on.

FfiSeriesPoint.description:
One point of a history series: a value and when it was recorded.

Every insight card draws a graphic of its own history, and the read carried
a series for two of eight generators. The rest carried summary numbers, so
a card either drew nothing or the sheet behind it read the engine again per
open. One shape serves all of them: a lap time against its activity date, an
eFTP against its day, a critical speed against its snapshot.

days.description: The span's length in days, back from today.

source.description: `None` when no ride inside the span qualifies.

FfiSpanDecoupling.description: The ride the decoupling card names for one span of the range picker.

laps.description:
The laps with a finite delta over each split, which its figures come
from.

FfiSplitSummary.description:
Each split's distribution of `split_delta_secs` over a direction's laps,
the reference left out, in travel order. A split's median is NaN under
the laps a typical lap needs and its quartiles NaN under the laps a spread
needs.

FfiSportFamily.description:
The family a sport is drawn and filtered in, in stack order. The feed's
chips and the map's counts are one per family, and Other takes every
sport no family lists, so a sport nobody listed still answers to a chip.

sportGroup.description: The sport the entry stands for, as the API spells it ("Ride", "Run").

FfiSportLoad.description:
One sport's contribution to a day's load, as intervals.icu's `sportInfo`
carries it. The fitness chart's daily load bar is the sum of these.

dominant.description:
"Cycling", "Running" or "Swimming", whichever counts the most. `None`
for an empty library or a tie, which is no evidence for either sport.

FfiSportMix.description: The latest activities by the three sports the fitness tab draws.

sport.description: The family's first sport type, the key a write names.

hrZones.description: The sport's heart rate zone edges and where they came from.

powerZones.description:
The upper edge of each power zone as a percent of FTP, empty when the
sport settings list none.

FfiSportThresholds.description: The figures of one sport family.

daysToFinish.description:
The whole days the tracks still owed take on the daily backfill share,
or `None` when they fit in one day.

FfiStagedHistory.description:
The library at a staged cut, as tracks with a decided elevation out of all
the tracks the download can ask about.

daysSinceLast.description:
Days since the last traversal. The insight gates on this, so it has to
travel with the opportunity rather than be recovered downstream.

unit.description: "W" for power, "/km" for running, "/100m" for swimming

sportType.description:
The sport the section was ranked under. A section travelled in two
sports is ranked in each, and the card names which one it is offering.

recentEfforts.description:
The last efforts on the section, oldest first, with the record's own
effort in front when it is older than all of them. The card's claim is
that a fitness gain makes the section worth revisiting, and the efforts
are what that claim is drawn against.

bestActivityId.description: The activity the record being offered for a retry was set in.

prDate.description:
When the record was set, epoch seconds. `previous_value` is the
fitness on this day.

prPower.description:
The record effort's mean power in watts, for a cycling section whose
record carried a power stream. Absent otherwise, never a zero.

prSpeed.description:
The record effort's mean speed in m/s, for a running or swimming
section. Absent for cycling.

prSharePercent.description:
The record effort as a percent of the fitness held that day: power
over eFTP for cycling, speed over critical speed for running and
swimming. Absent when the effort is.

fitnessHistory.description:
The fitness `previous_value` and `current_value` are read from, oldest
first, from the first of `recent_efforts` to the newest value, with a
point at `pr_date` carrying `previous_value`.

FfiStalePrOpportunity.description:
One stale-PR opportunity: a section whose PR might be beatable because
the user's threshold fitness (FTP for cycling, critical speed for run/swim)
has improved since the PR was set, and the section hasn't been visited
recently. Pure pattern recognition - TS formats as an Insight.

glyph.description: The glyph `trend_table::glyph` draws for the move.

percent.description:
The size of the move in whole percent of the earlier total, absent for
a move inside the deadband.

change.description:
The signed move in percent of the earlier total, unrounded, for a card
that prints its own precision.

FfiStatTrend.description:
One total of a period against the same elapsed part of the period before,
judged once in the engine.

seconds.description: The width the block takes, in seconds of the plan.

zone.description:
The athlete's training zone, 1 to 7, that the step's target falls in.
`None` for a rest step and for a step with no target a zone can be
worked out from.

FfiStepBlock.description: One block of the step bar, one per plan line.

units.description: The units as the plan wrote them: `%ftp`, `w`, `power_zone` and so on.

absolute.description: Present only when the plan carries a positive threshold to convert by.

FfiStepTarget.description: A step's target as the plan supplied it, a single value being a range of one.

id.description: Stable id the front end keys its copy on, e.g. `biceps_triceps`

leftWeightedSets.description: Weighted sets on each side, rounded to one decimal, as the verdict saw them

dominantSlug.description: The heavier side, or `None` when the two are equal

ratio.description:
Heavier over lighter. `None` when either side is untrained, where a
ratio is not a number: `status` carries that case.

FfiStrengthBalancePair.description:
One opposing pair of muscle groups, and what their volumes say about it.

The verdict is a function of the volumes beside it, so it is computed where
they are rather than per screen mount. The pair's name and the muscles'
display names are copy and stay in TypeScript, which is where the seventeen
locales are.

settled.description:
Stored sets exist, or the FIT file has a recorded outcome. False means a
download is still owed, in flight or failed, so an empty card says nothing.

activeSetCount.description: Rest, warmup and cooldown sets are not counted.

exerciseCount.description: Distinct exercise names among the active sets.

totalVolumeKg.description: Weight times repetitions over active sets.

muscles.description: Muscle groups the active sets work, primary over secondary.

FfiStrengthCardSummary.description: What one strength feed card paints, read for a batch of activities at once.

progressions.description: One entry per muscle in `monthly`, in its order.

FfiStrengthInsightSeries.description:
Bundled strength aggregation for the insights hook: one monthly summary
plus N weekly summaries, each keyed to the corresponding input range.
Collapses 5+ separate `getStrengthSummary` FFI calls into one round-trip.

weeklyWeightedSets.description:
Weighted sets for each week of `weekly`, oldest first, rounded to one
decimal before the averages below are taken. The order matters: the
reader rounded first and an average of unrounded weeks disagrees.

changePct.description: `None` when the baseline is zero, which has no percentage to report.

signalDelta.description:
How far the recent average sits from the baseline, in standard
deviations of the weekly series. `None` when the series is flat or
shorter than two weeks.

FfiStrengthProgression.description:
One muscle's trailing-weeks progression: the last two weekly averages
against the first two. Ranked here rather than in the reader, so the
weekly summaries are never walked again to re-find figures this call
already had.

summary.description: The chosen period aggregated by muscle, with the balance verdicts.

weekly.description: One aggregate per trailing week, in the order requested.

progressions.description: One entry per muscle present in any of those weeks, most trained first.

exercises.description: The exercises behind every muscle the period reached.

owedCount.description:
Strength activities in the period with no FIT outcome yet, whose sets
are owed rather than absent.

FfiStrengthScreenData.description:
Everything the strength tab paints with. All four are aggregates of the
same sets over the same windows, so they are one read rather than four: a
scrub across the diagram then costs no engine call at all.

startTs.description: Start of the summary's range in Unix seconds, or zero for an undated aggregate.

activityCount.description: Number of WeightTraining activities in the period

totalSets.description: Total active sets across all activities

balance.description: One entry per opposing pair, trained or not

maxWeightedSets.description:
The most trained muscle's weighted sets, the top of the diagram's
scale, or zero when nothing was trained

FfiStrengthSummary.description: Summary of strength training volume over a time period.

FfiStubVerdict.description:
What a feed card says about a stub, an activity intervals.icu holds but
does not serve. The one judge for the card, beside [`state`] for the page.

weekHoursTrend.description:
The arrow for this week's hours so far against the same part of the
week before, on hours rounded to a tenth as the card prints them.

weekCountTrend.description: The same for this week's activity count.

FfiSummaryCardData.description:
Summary card batch data: combines period stats, FTP trend, and pace trends.
Reduces Home screen FFI calls from 5 to 1.

currentCoverage.description: Whether each period's activities are on the device, by the census.

FfiSummaryComparison.description:
A period against an earlier one, each window inclusive at both ends. A
trend is absent when the earlier period has none of that total, so nothing
is compared with zero, and every trend is absent while either period is
not fully on the device.

week.description: Monday to now, against the same weekday and hour of last week.

threeMonths.description: This calendar month and the two before it, to now.

sixMonths.description: This calendar month and the five before it, to now.

FfiSummaryComparisons.description: Every range the weekly card offers, so a tap between them reads nothing.

FfiSyncErrorReason.description:
Why the last sync failed, as the kind the banner branches on.

The message beside it stays, because it carries the detail a bug report
needs, but it is never the thing an athlete reads. A locale table keyed on
the message would break the first time one is reworded, so the classifying
happens here, where the engine already knows which case it is in.

The wire carries the variant's position, so the order here is the contract:
append, never reorder. The discriminants start at one so no member is falsy.

stepItemsDone.description:
Activities the running per-activity step has handled, of
`step_items_total`. Both are zero for a step that is not a walk over
activities, and between steps.

stepItemsTotal.description: Activities the running per-activity step owes, read when it began.

step.description:
Which endpoint the run is on, or `None` when nothing is running. The
counters beside it count steps, so this is the only field that says
what the sync is actually doing.

lastErrorReason.description:
Which kind of failure the message describes, so the banner can render a
translated line rather than the engine's own English.

lastSuccessAt.description:
When a run last finished clean, as a millisecond RFC 3339 instant in
UTC. Read from the settings row each time, so a wipe or a restore is
reflected with no copy to clear. `None` before any clean run.

retryAtMs.description:
When the work the last run left owed is asked for again, as epoch
milliseconds, when it ended on a refusal or a deferral from the
request budget. The engine resumes it itself at this time.

tracks.description:
The track work running beside the sync or after it: the GPS download,
section detection or the heatmap pass, whichever comes first in that
order, or `None` when none of them is running. Independent of `state`,
which is the metadata sync's alone, so a pass the engine starts by
itself after the sync has settled is reported all the same.

heldBackInLastDownload.description:
How many activities the last download newly marked as held back by
intervals.icu, which it serves as empty stubs. Zero before any download
and after one that found none.

FfiSyncStatus.description: The status fields TypeScript reads / subscribes to.

FfiSyncStep.description:
Which endpoint a running sync is on, so the line an athlete reads names the
work rather than a counter.

The step is the engine's to report. `completed` counts steps that landed,
so a label derived from it in TypeScript lags by one for every step that
failed, and goes wrong outright the first time the order moves.

The wire carries the variant's position, so the order here is the contract:
append, never reorder. The discriminants start at one so no member is falsy.

FfiTargetMetric.description: The measure one step target is set in.

FfiThresholdField.description: One of the figures the thresholds screen lets the athlete set.

FfiThresholdFigure.description: One figure with its value and source, both unset when nothing gives it.

FfiThresholdSource.description: Where a threshold figure shown on the thresholds screen came from.

hrZoneDefaultPercents.description:
The upper edge of each heart rate zone, as a percent of maximum heart
rate, used when the athlete's sport settings list no zones of their own.

FfiThresholdsScreenData.description: What the thresholds settings screen shows.

FfiTimestampRange.description: Inclusive Unix-second range used for batched summary requests.

completed.description:
Items the step has handled, of `total`: tracks for the download, tiles
for the heatmap, the current phase's items for detection.

total.description: Zero while the step has not counted its work yet.

percent.description:
The step's own progress, 0 to 100. Detection weights its phases, so
this is not always `completed` of `total`.

resumesAtMs.description:
When a held download starts again, as epoch milliseconds. `None` for
every other step. The counts beside it are zero: the window's own
coverage says how many tracks are still owed.

heldCause.description:
Who asked for the wait, when the step is `Held`. `None` for every other
step.

FfiTrackStage.description: The running piece of the track work and how far it has got.

FfiTrackStep.description:
Which piece of the track work is running.

The wire carries the variant's position, so the order here is the contract:
append, never reorder. The discriminants start at one so no member is falsy.

FfiTrendBandPoint.description: One point on a trend curve with its band, clamped to the attempts' range.

nearestM.description: How close the track comes to the point, in metres.

id.description: The route or the section, `None` for the activities in no route.

name.description: The name the athlete gave the route or the section.

number.description: The number an unnamed route is shown under.

count.description: How many activities of this group pass under the point, before the cap.

sportTypes.description:
The sports of a route's attempts, or the section's sport. Empty for the activities in no
route.

distanceM.description: The route's representative's length, or the section's, in metres. Zero for no route.

passes.description: A route's counted attempts, a section's visit count. Zero for no route.

bestTime.description: Moving time in seconds of the fastest counted attempt.

lastDate.description: Unix seconds of the latest counted attempt.

activities.description: The group's activities that fit under the cap, newest first.

FfiUnderPointGroup.description:
The activities under a point that belong to one route or one section, or
to no route.

FfiUnderPointKind.description: What an under-point group collects the activities of.

hours.description:
The families with moving time that week, in the order a stack of them
is drawn; empty for a week with no activity.

FfiWeeklyHours.description: One week's moving hours, by the sport families that have any.

start.description: Epoch seconds of the week's first instant.

partial.description: The week is still running, so its totals cover only the days so far.

FfiWeeklyTotal.description: One week's totals and when the week starts.

FfiWeightUnit.description: The unit an athlete reads and enters strength weight in.

rampRate.description: Change in `ctl` over the week to the day.

sportLoad.description:
Empty for a day synced before the body column existed, and for a day
the API sent no per-sport breakdown for.

source.description:
`veloq` for a day whose fitness, fatigue and ramp rate Veloq folded
from its own loads, absent for a day intervals.icu served.

FfiWellnessDay.description:
One stored wellness day, typed. This is what the wellness and fitness
screens read: every field they render, and nothing else.

The untyped body stays in the `raw` column for the Rust-side eFTP
derivation, which reads fields no screen does. It no longer crosses the
FFI, so no screen parses JSON to draw a chart.

form.description:
Beside `days`, one per day: form in the unit the athlete reads it in,
rounded fitness less rounded fatigue, or that as a percentage of
rounded fitness under `form_as_percent`. Absent on a day missing a
load, and under the percentage on a day whose fitness rounds to zero.

formAsPercent.description:
Whether `form` is a percentage of fitness rather than absolute TSB,
from the athlete's `icu_form_as_percent`.

formZoneEdges.description:
Where the form zones change in either unit, lowest first: below the
first is high risk, then optimal, grey zone, fresh, and from the last
transition.

FfiWellnessDays.description:
The stored wellness days of a window and whether the window was pulled.

An empty `days` is either a window the account holds nothing in or one the
device never downloaded, and the charts drawing it said the same for both.

hrvRead.description:
Beside `hrv`, one per day: whether that day had a reading of its own
or carries an earlier one forward. A scrub reads it so a filled day is
not labelled with a value that was measured on another. Empty with
`hrv`.

fitnessDelta.description: Last plotted fitness minus the first. `None` under two values.

fitnessRiseDays.description:
Indices into `fitness` of the days fitness rose over the day before by
more than one CTL point.

FfiWellnessSparklines.description:
Sparkline payload for the SummaryCard: rounded integer arrays, oldest
first, forward-filled where needed so renderers produce continuous lines.
Empty arrays mean "not enough data" (TS renders `undefined` / skips).

fatigue.description: The newest row's fatigue, rounded as `fitness` is. It has no arrow of its own.

FfiWellnessSummary.description:
The summary card's numbers and the arrow beside each.

A glyph is the engine's judgement of improvement. `None` means the
comparison had no nearby baseline or enough earlier readings.

Beside each arrow is what it was judged against, so the card can state the
method: `*_previous` is the baseline value, `*_previous_date` the day it was
read (Unix timestamp seconds of that day's midnight, UTC, as `FfiFtpTrend`
dates its estimates), and `*_basis` the evidence behind the claim. A metric
with no baseline row carries no previous value and no date.

previousBestTimeSecs.description: Second-best time (prior PR before current best)

trend.description:
-1 = declining, 0 = stable, 1 = improving. None when there is not
enough history to say.

FfiWorkoutSection.description:
Enriched workout section for the home-screen "Sections for you" list.
Composes ranking + performance lookups server-side so the TS hook is a
thin pass-through instead of a per-section FFI loop.

FfiZoneBounds.description:
The upper edge of each zone. From sport settings the edges are bpm; by
default they are percents of maximum heart rate.

seconds.description: Seconds per zone, lowest zone first. Empty for an unknown zone type.

shares.description:
Each zone's share of the time as a whole percent, beside `seconds`,
totalling 100 when any zone holds time and all zero when none does.

names.description:
The names the cached sport settings give the zones, lowest first, never
more than `seconds` holds.
Empty when the settings do not name them.

FfiZoneDistribution.description: A sport's time in each zone, with the athlete's own name for each zone.

FfiZoneSource.description: Where a list of zone edges came from.

upstream.description: Activities the server says the account holds.

fetched.description: Of those, the ones stored locally at the version the census names.

tracksUpstream.description: Activities the server says carry a GPS track.

tracksStored.description: Of those, the ones whose track is on the device.

LibraryCoverage.description:
The four counts the sync row reports, for the signed-in athlete.

Two pairs rather than one: the activity pages arrive with the window syncs
and the tracks with the GPS pass, so one can be current while the other is
short, and a single fraction would hide whichever is further behind.

All four are zero for an athlete whose census has never been pulled. Nothing
is known about the account then, and a zero pair reads as nothing to report.

isVirtual.description:
Whether the sport is recorded in a simulated world, so its track is not
where the athlete rides.

startLat.description:
Where the ride began, for the marker. `None` leaves the caller the
bounds centre, which is where every marker used to start out before the
signatures finished loading and moved it.

date.description: Start date as Unix timestamp (seconds since epoch)

MapActivityComplete.description:
Complete activity data for map display.
Contains both spatial bounds and metadata for filtering and display.

MapDistanceBand.description: Distance range selected for the map in the current unit system.

RangeCoverage.description:
Whether a date range holds nothing, owes a download, or is fully local.

Activities are judged against the census, wellness against what is stored:
intervals.icu answers a wellness row for every day of the athlete's history,
so for wellness `NotFetched` is nothing stored at all.

The wire carries the variant's position, so the order here is the contract:
append, never reorder. The discriminants start at one so no member is falsy.

activityCount.description: Rides whose first or last fix falls in the cluster.

endpointShare.description: Endpoints in the cluster, of every endpoint in the library.

SuggestedHome.description: A home the athlete can confirm, and how sure the guess is.

SyncState.description:
The lifecycle state TypeScript renders.

Crosses as an enum: the word was stringified here and spelt again in a
TypeScript mirror, and every reader only ever branches on it. Wire order
is declaration order, so append and never reorder.
